common_prompt.en: Assume your basic living needs are covered, and judge whether each choice below describes you. There are no right answers.

rules.0.en: No total health score is calculated, and no disease probability, pain weight, treatment effect, willingness to pay or refusal of treatment is inferred
rules.0.zh: 不计算总健康分，不推断患病概率、疼痛权重、疗效、愿付金额或拒绝治疗

rules.1.en: Health answers take none of the six areas' 100 points and are not a seventh scoring weight; they only inform the clones' planning and do not change illness rules, γ, H, accounts or satisfaction
rules.1.zh: 健康回答不占六维 100 分，也不是第七个评分权重；只供分身做计划，不改变疾病规则、γ、H、账目或满足感

rules.2.en: The questions are provisional wording, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale
rules.2.zh: 题目是暂定文案，没有经过认知访谈或量表验证

unanswered_rule.en: An unanswered question is stored as “not answered”, separately from “not sure yet”; both mean there is no explicit instruction for that item, and no middle value is filled in
unanswered_rule.zh: 没有作答另存为“未答”，与“暂不确定”分开；两者都表示没有这一项的明确指令，不补中间值

leisure_states.0.en: Not answered: no explicit information on this item, evaluated with neutral rules; it is never treated as choosing the “generic evaluation”
leisure_states.0.zh: 未答：没有这一项的明确信息，按中性规则评价；不会被当成“通用评价”的选择

leisure_states.1.en: Not sure yet: evaluated with neutral rules
leisure_states.1.zh: 暂不确定：按中性规则评价

leisure_states.2.en: Explicitly no fixed hobby: evaluated with neutral rules
leisure_states.2.zh: 明确没有固定爱好：按中性规则评价

leisure_states.3.en: Use the generic leisure evaluation: try whatever suitable the city offers (evaluated with neutral rules)
leisure_states.3.zh: 采用通用休闲评价：城市有什么合适的就体验什么（按中性规则评价）

leisure_states.4.en: Describe in words: candidates are first formed from the vocabulary, and only the categories you choose enter the evaluation; unrecognized descriptions are kept as written and not evaluated in this version
leisure_states.4.zh: 用文字描述：先按词表形成候选，你选中的类别才进入评价；没认出的描述原样保留，本版不评价

matching_note.en: A confirmed interest only brings moderately higher satisfaction for the same actual time spent (model assumption: 50% more, with a cap); a confirmed cuisine only makes meals to your taste that you actually eat count a little more. These coefficients are publicly registered model assumptions, not measurements of you; they do not change your points, cash or qualifications, and do not make expensive things automatically better
matching_note.zh: 确认的兴趣只在同样的实际参与时间下带来适度更高的满足（模型假设：多 50%，有上限）；确认的菜系只让实际吃到的合口味餐多计一点。 这些系数是公开登记的模型假设，不是对你个人的测量；不改变你的点数、现金或资格，也不让贵的东西自动更好

taste_states.0.en: Not answered: evaluated with neutral rules

taste_states.1.en: Not sure yet: evaluated with neutral rules
taste_states.1.zh: 暂不确定：按中性规则评价

taste_states.2.en: Explicitly no taste preference: evaluated with neutral rules
taste_states.2.zh: 明确没有口味偏好：按中性规则评价

taste_states.3.en: Describe in words: candidates are first formed from the vocabulary, and only the cuisines you choose enter the food evaluation; brands and other requirements are only kept
taste_states.3.zh: 用文字描述：先按词表形成候选，你选中的菜系才进入饮食评价；品牌与其他要求只留存

item.0.en: Cities, quotes, wages, taxes, illness and treatment are all synthetic settings; the results do not rank real cities and are not real-world recommendations
item.0.zh: 城市、报价、工资、税、疾病与治疗全部是合成设定；结果不排序真实城市，也不是现实推荐

item.1.en: The offline planner is a controllable mock and does not represent a real large language model's ability or understanding of preferences
item.1.zh: 离线规划器是可控的 mock，不代表真实大语言模型的能力或偏好理解

item.2.en: The questionnaire wording and reference improvement ranges are provisional drafts, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale
item.2.zh: 问卷文案与参考改善范围是暂定稿，没有做认知访谈与量表验证

canonical_form.en: A whole number after reducing (30) or numerator/denominator (50/3); calculations and comparisons use it, display rounds to 1 decimal place, and displayed values never feed back into calculations
canonical_form.zh: 约分后的整数（30）或 分子/分母（50/3）；计算与比较都用它，显示四舍五入到 1 位小数，显示值不回流计算

manual_entry.en: Manual entries are parsed as exact decimals with at most 2 decimal places (the step is not a measurement precision); fractions in lowest terms are also accepted (for example 50/3)
manual_entry.zh: 手工输入按精确十进制解析，最多 2 位小数（步长不是测量精度）；也接受规范分数写法（例如 50/3）

rules.0.en: The six areas must add up to exactly 100; no values are pre-filled, no personality presets are offered, and other items are never reduced proportionally
rules.0.zh: 六维合计必须精确等于 100；不预填数值、不提供人格套餐，不自动按比例扣减其他项

rules.1.en: An equal split is generated only when the user chooses “split equally” (50/3 for each of the six areas, 25 for each material item), so items listed first get no extra points
rules.1.zh: 只有用户主动选择“平均分配”才生成均分（六维每项 50/3、物质每项 25），不让排在前面的项目多拿分

rules.2.en: An explicit 0 is a provided value; “not answered”, “explicitly no strong view” and “not sure yet” are never turned into 0 or an equal share automatically
rules.2.zh: 明确 0 是已提供的数值；“未答”“明确无所谓”“暂不确定”都不会被自动换成 0 或均分

rules.3.en: When material life is positive, the four material items must also add up to exactly 100; when material life is explicitly 0, the breakdown does not apply and no four answers are invented
rules.3.zh: 物质父项为正时，物质四项也必须精确合计 100；物质父项明确为 0 时细分不适用，不伪造四个回答

rules.4.en: Since material life went from three items to four and the meaning of food widened, old confirmations cannot be carried over by adding a 0 or redistributing points: please review and confirm again
rules.4.zh: 物质从三项改成四项、饮食的含义扩大之后，旧的确认不能补 0 或重新分配点数沿用：请重新审阅并确认

item.0.en: This is a simplified scenario of moving to a candidate city and starting over: it starts in year 1, healthy, with no belongings, no courses in progress and no savings goal
item.0.zh: 这是一次搬到候选城市重新开始的简化情景：从第 1 年、健康、没有已有物品、没有在学课程、没有资金目标开始

item.1.en: Real old furniture, medical history and ongoing courses are not included yet; this is an assumption of the simulation, not a judgement about your real situation
item.1.zh: 现实中的旧家具、病史与在学课程暂未纳入；这是模拟的假设，不是对你现实情况的判断

item.2.en: The same you has the same age, cash, abilities and base time and energy in every city and every clone; specific jobs in a city are matched against the local catalogue
item.2.zh: 同一个你在各城市、各个分身里的年龄、现金、能力与基础时间精力都相同；城市里的具体岗位按当地目录匹配

item.0.en: Fixed remote income, shared household assets, multi-person households, buying a home and loans
item.0.zh: 固定远程收入、家庭共同资产、多人家庭、买房与贷款

item.1.zh: 跨国比较与跨币种的财富换算

item.2.en: Scoring of brands, cuisines, preparation, tier, service quality and home-visit concerns (the text is only recorded)
item.2.zh: 品牌、菜系、制作方式、档次、服务质量与上门顾虑的评分（只记录原文）

item.3.en: Pausing monthly services that need none of your time during illness to save money
item.3.zh: 生病时暂停零参与时间的按月服务来省钱

item.4.en: Interview-style input (only the interfaces for sources and evidence references are kept)
item.4.zh: 访谈式输入（只保留来源与证据引用接口）

note.zh: 合成城市：人工服务便宜、设备贵；其余与 K51 相同

meaning.en: A synthetic index of the city's career and growth opportunities, 0–10; higher means the city itself offers better conditions for development (not including your own learning progress). Not real employment or education statistics
meaning.zh: 合成的城市职业与成长机会指数，0–10，越高表示城市本身提供的发展条件越好（不含你自己的学习进度）。不是真实的 就业或教育统计

meaning.en: A synthetic index of the city's environmental quality (a synthetic summary of air, green space and noise), 0–10; higher is better. Not real environmental monitoring data
meaning.zh: 合成的城市环境质量指数（空气、绿地、噪声的合成概括），0–10，越高越好。不是真实的环境监测数据

meaning.en: A synthetic index of the city's leisure facilities and public space, 0–10; higher means better leisure you can enjoy without spending money (fitness, experiences and the like are arranged separately). Not real facility statistics
meaning.zh: 合成的城市休闲设施与公共空间指数，0–10，越高表示不花钱也能享受的休闲条件越好（健身、体验等要另外安排）。不是 真实的设施统计

meaning.en: A synthetic index of the city's safety conditions, 0–10; higher is safer. Not the crime rate or statistical definition of any real city; comparable only within this set of synthetic cities
meaning.zh: 合成的城市安全条件指数，0–10，越高越安全。不是任何真实城市的犯罪率或统计口径，只在这组合成城市之间可比

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: with 20 days on site a month, the daily round trip shrinking from 70 to 30 minutes
reference_improvement.zh: 参考情境：每月到岗 20 次时，每天往返从 70 分钟缩短到 30 分钟

support_note.en: Scored on the round-trip minutes from the home you actually live in and the days you actually go to work; non-work trips are not detailed in this version

definition.zh: 空气、气候与城市环境的背景条件

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: a synthetic environment index rising from 4 to 8 (0–10, comparable only among this set of synthetic cities)
reference_improvement.zh: 参考情境：合成环境指数从 4 提高到 8（0–10，只在本组合成城市之间可比）

support_note.en: This version has only the city's background conditions; clones cannot improve it by acting
support_note.zh: 本版只有城市背景条件，分身不能行动改善它

definition.en: The city's basic leisure conditions, plus exercise, shows and other activities you actually take part in
definition.zh: 城市基础休闲条件，加上实际参加的锻炼、演出等活动

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: from no activities at all each month to going to the gym 8 times a month
reference_improvement.zh: 参考情境：从每月不参加任何活动，到每月去 8 次健身房

support_note.en: Only activities that actually happen count; matching specific hobbies to geography is not in this version
support_note.zh: 只算实际发生的活动；具体爱好与地理的匹配本版没有

definition.en: What you actually get from consumption: the condition of your home, whether food is fresh and to your taste, whether phone, internet and household supplies are convenient, whether daily chores are easy, and clothing and personal care (split into four items inside)
definition.zh: 住的房子条件、吃得是否新鲜合口味、通信联网与日用品是否方便、日常杂务是否省心、衣着与个人护理等实际消费得到的条件（内部再分四项）

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: from a one-bedroom far away, eating mostly rice, flour and canned food and doing all the laundry and cleaning yourself, to three fresh-ingredient meals a day and about 18 fewer hours of housework a month (one step of improvement in this version's synthetic model)
reference_improvement.zh: 参考情境：从远处一居室、以米面罐头为主、洗衣打扫全部自己做，改善到每天三顿新鲜食材、每月少做约 18 小时家务（本版合成模型里的一档改善）

support_note.en: Housing condition, food, daily support and convenience, and personal consumption and enjoyment are all scored on actual life; other material needs such as storage are not in this version
support_note.zh: 居住条件、饮食生活、日常支持与便利、个人消费与享受四项都按实际生活评分；储物等其他物质需求本版没有

definition.en: The career and growth conditions the city offers, plus new abilities you actually learn in your life
definition.zh: 城市提供的职业与成长条件，加上你在生活中实际学到的新能力

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: finishing a 12-month qualification course within a year, or the city's opportunity conditions rising from a synthetic index of 4 to 8

support_note.en: City background + the learning you actually take part in; certificates themselves, job changes and pay rises earn nothing extra

definition.zh: 在其他生活开支之外，获得衣着、个人护理等个人消费的满足。
