Supply status (offered / definitely not offered / unknown), data status and compile status are recorded separately: definitely not offered is a settled survey result, but not a purchasable option. This is a different judgment from whether actual trajectories can be scored or a clone's C / E / M: catalog gaps do not rewrite the scoring of trajectories that already happened
catalog.inventory.not_exhaustive.zh: 这只说明声明范围内调查过的候选资料齐不齐，不保证穷尽整个城市市场；没有记录不等于城市没有。供给状态（有卖 / 确定没有 / 不知道）、资料状态与编译状态分开记：确定没有是已确定的调查结果，但不是可购买的方案。它与实际轨迹能否评分、分身的 C / E / M 是不同的判断：目录缺口不改写已发生轨迹的评分

catalog.inventory.not_offered.en: Confirmed that this city does not offer this option: the survey result is settled, but it is not a purchasable option
catalog.inventory.not_offered.zh: 已证实这座城没有这项方案：调查结果已确定，但它不是可购买的方案

catalog.lifetime_not_integer.message.en: A lifetime of {years} years is not a whole number: E1 accepts only whole years and does not round silently
catalog.lifetime_not_integer.message.zh: 寿命 {years} 年不是整数：E1 只接受整数年，不静默取整

catalog.lifetime_not_integer.next.en: Provide lifetime data in whole years, or register an explicit conversion rule
catalog.lifetime_not_integer.next.zh: 提供整数年的寿命资料，或登记明确的换算规则

catalog.lifetime_out_of_range.message.en: A lifetime of {years} years is not between 1 and {max} years
catalog.lifetime_out_of_range.message.zh: 寿命 {years} 年不在 1–{max} 年之间

catalog.lifetime_out_of_range.next.en: Check the unit (were months written as years?)

catalog.lifetime_unknown.impact.en: This device cannot be compiled into the catalog; its supply status is kept as recorded (on sale is not the same as definitely unavailable)
catalog.lifetime_unknown.impact.zh: 这项设备不能编入目录；它的供给状态照实保留（有卖不等于确定买不到）

catalog.lifetime_unknown.message.en: Data on how many years the device lasts is missing: durable goods that E1 can execute need an explicit whole number of years from 1 to 30, and no “typical lifetime” is filled in
catalog.lifetime_unknown.message.zh: 设备能用几年的资料缺失：E1 可执行的耐用品要求明确的 1–30 整数年，不按“常见寿命”补值

catalog.lifetime_unknown.next.en: Add lifetime data, or register an explicit assumption shared by the whole group
catalog.lifetime_unknown.next.zh: 补充寿命资料，或登记全组共用的明确假设

catalog.not_offered.impact.en: This is a settled survey result; it is not a purchasable option, so it is not compiled into the catalog
catalog.not_offered.impact.zh: 这是已确定的调查结果；它不是可购买的方案，所以不编入目录

catalog.not_offered.message.en: The data shows that this city definitely does not offer this option
catalog.not_offered.message.zh: 资料显示这座城确定没有这项方案

catalog.not_offered.next.en: No data is needed; update it if the data changes
catalog.not_offered.next.zh: 无需补资料；资料变了再更新

catalog.participation_invalid.impact.en: This service cannot be compiled into the catalog (the other candidates compile as usual)
catalog.participation_invalid.impact.zh: 这项服务不能编入目录（其他候选照常编译）

catalog.participation_invalid.message.en: The personal-participation data is not a number ≥ 0 with at most two decimals: {bad}
catalog.participation_invalid.message.zh: 本人参与资料不是不小于 0、最多两位小数的数：{bad}

catalog.participation_invalid.next.en: Check your monthly participation hours and the burden per hour
catalog.participation_invalid.next.zh: 核对本人每月参与小时与每小时负担

catalog.participation_unknown.message.en: Data on how many hours a month the service needs from you is missing (not treated as 0)
catalog.participation_unknown.message.zh: 服务需要本人每月参与多少小时的资料缺失（不当 0）

catalog.participation_unknown.next.en: Add your participation time and burden
catalog.participation_unknown.next.zh: 补充本人参与时间与负担

catalog.price_basis_mismatch.impact.en: Money on different bases cannot go into the same ledger
catalog.price_basis_mismatch.impact.zh: 不同口径的钱不能进同一本账

catalog.price_basis_mismatch.message.en: The quote basis is {quote}; the data pack's catalog basis is {pack}/local base-year price
catalog.price_basis_mismatch.message.zh: 报价口径是 {quote}，资料包的目录口径是 {pack}/当地基年价

catalog.price_basis_mismatch.next.en: Provide a quote on the same basis, or first register an auditable conversion
catalog.price_basis_mismatch.next.zh: 提供同口径的报价，或先登记可审计的换算

catalog.price_field_missing.message.en: The price is marked as known but lacks {missing}: the basis of the amount cannot be determined
catalog.price_field_missing.message.zh: 报价标为已知，但缺少 {missing}：不能确定金额的口径

catalog.price_field_missing.next.en: Fill in the price's amount, currency, base year, local-price basis and billing period
catalog.price_field_missing.next.zh: 补齐报价的金额、币种、基年、当地价口径与计费周期

catalog.price_not_a_number.message.en: The price is not a non-negative number

catalog.price_too_precise.message.en: The price {amount} cannot be represented exactly in the smallest accounting unit ({digits} decimal places): it is not rounded
catalog.price_too_precise.message.zh: 报价 {amount} 不能精确表示为最小记账单位（{digits} 位小数）：不四舍五入

catalog.price_too_precise.next.en: Check the price and write it with at most two decimal places
catalog.price_too_precise.next.zh: 核对报价，写成最多两位小数的金额

catalog.price_unit_missing.message.en: No pricing unit is given (for example per device set or per service month): the system will not fill in appliance-set or service-month automatically
catalog.price_unit_missing.message.zh: 没有写计价单位（例如每套设备、每服务月）：系统不会自动补成 appliance-set 或 service-month

catalog.price_unit_unregistered.message.en: The pricing unit “{per_unit}” has no registered pricing object (set / machine / service month / visit): cannot check whether the price source prices the same object
catalog.price_unit_unregistered.message.zh: 计价单位“{per_unit}”没有登记它对应的计价对象（套 / 台 / 服务月 / 次）：不能核对报价来源是不是按同一对象计价

catalog.price_unit_unregistered.next.en: Use a registered pricing unit, or first register the pricing object for this unit
catalog.price_unit_unregistered.next.zh: 改用已登记的计价单位，或先登记这个计价单位对应的计价对象

catalog.residual_invalid.message.en: A residual of {hours} hours/month is not between 0 and the baseline {base} (at most two decimals)
catalog.residual_invalid.message.zh: 残余 {hours} 小时/月不在 0 到基准 {base} 之间（最多两位小数）

catalog.residual_invalid.next.en: Check the residual hours: it is the monthly time you still need after handling the whole chore
catalog.residual_invalid.next.zh: 核对残余小时：它是本人处理整项家务后仍需的月时间

catalog.residual_task_duplicated.message.en: Chore {task} appears {times} times in the relief effect ({values} hours/month): a chore can have only one residual, and the system will not choose for you or take the minimum (identical duplicates are rejected too)
catalog.residual_task_duplicated.message.zh: 家务 {task} 在减负效果里出现了 {times} 次（{values} 小时/月）：同一项家务只能有一个残余小时，系统不替你选，也不取最小值（内容完全相同的重复也拒绝）

catalog.residual_task_duplicated.next.en: Keep only one residual-hours entry per chore
catalog.residual_task_duplicated.next.zh: 每项家务只保留一条残余小时

catalog.source_billing_mismatch.en: The {field} source {fact} is a {period} price ({unit}), while the candidate is a {billing} price: there is no explicit conversion basis (for example visits per month), so a price for one period is not treated as another's
catalog.source_billing_mismatch.zh: {field}的来源 {fact} 是{period}的价格（{unit}），候选是{billing}的价格：没有明确的换算依据（例如每月几次），不把一种周期的价格当成另一种

catalog.source_field_mismatch.message.en: {field} cites fact {fact}, which records {recorded}: it cannot directly support {field} (deriving across fields requires a stated method, and this version registers none)
catalog.source_field_mismatch.message.zh: {field}引用的事实 {fact} 记录的是 {recorded}：不能直接支持{field}（跨字段推导需要写明方法，本版没有登记任何跨字段推导）

catalog.source_field_mismatch.next.en: Cite a fact that records {field} itself

catalog.source_missing.message.en: {field} has a value but cites no source fact: it cannot count as complete data, and no source or synthetic note is generated automatically
catalog.source_missing.message.zh: {field}有值，但没有引用任何来源事实：不能当作资料齐全，也不会自动生成来源或合成说明

catalog.source_missing.next.en: Add a source fact for {field} (real data gives a locator; synthetic settings state their assumption)
catalog.source_missing.next.zh: 为{field}补上来源事实（真实资料写定位；合成设定写明假设说明）

catalog.source_object_mismatch.en: The {field} source {fact} prices per “{kind}”, while the candidate's pricing unit {per_unit} prices per “{want}”: not the same pricing object, and there is no automatic conversion
catalog.source_object_mismatch.zh: {field}的来源 {fact} 按“{kind}”计价，候选的计价单位 {per_unit} 按“{want}”计价：不是同一个计价对象，不自动换算

catalog.source_unit.next.en: Cite a fact with the same pricing basis, period and object, or first register an auditable conversion
catalog.source_unit.next.zh: 引用计价口径、周期与对象都相同的事实，或先登记可审计的换算

catalog.source_unit_mismatch.basis.en: {field} cites fact {fact} with the unit “{unit}”, whose currency, base year or local-price basis differs from the data pack's {basis} (no automatic conversion)
catalog.source_unit_mismatch.basis.zh: {field}引用的事实 {fact} 单位是“{unit}”，币种、基年或当地价口径与资料包的 {basis} 不同（不自动换算）

catalog.source_unit_mismatch.unit.en: {field} cites fact {fact} with the unit “{unit}”, which does not match the unit that {field} requires (no automatic conversion)
catalog.source_unit_mismatch.unit.zh: {field}引用的事实 {fact} 单位是“{unit}”，与{field}要求的单位不一致（不自动换算）

catalog.source_unit_unregistered.en: {field} cites fact {fact}, priced per “{denom}”, a pricing object that is not registered: cannot tell whether it is a per-visit, monthly or one-time price (no guessing)
catalog.source_unit_unregistered.zh: {field}引用的事实 {fact} 按“{denom}”计价，这种计价对象没有登记：不能判断它是按次、按月还是一次性的价格（不猜）

catalog.source_unknown_fact.message.en: {field} cites source fact {fact}, which does not exist in the data pack
catalog.source_unknown_fact.message.zh: {field}引用的来源事实 {fact} 在资料包里不存在

catalog.source_unknown_fact.next.en: Cite a fact ID registered in the data pack
catalog.source_unknown_fact.next.zh: 引用资料包里登记过的事实编号

catalog.source_value_mismatch.message.en: {field} {value} matches none of the cited source facts' raw values, and no derived or estimated fact states a conversion method
catalog.source_value_mismatch.message.zh: {field} {value} 与引用的来源事实的原始值都不一致，也没有写明换算方法的派生或估计事实

catalog.source_value_mismatch.next.en: Cite a fact whose raw value is this number, or register a derived / estimated fact that states its conversion method
catalog.source_value_mismatch.next.zh: 引用原始值就是这个数的事实，或登记写明换算方法的派生 / 估计事实

catalog.task_not_in_common_definition.im.en: Tasks or baselines cannot be set separately for each city
catalog.task_not_in_common_definition.im.zh: 不能按城市另设任务或基准

catalog.task_not_in_common_definition.me.en: Chore {task} is not in the task definitions shared by the group
catalog.task_not_in_common_definition.me.zh: 家务 {task} 不在全组共用的任务定义里

catalog.task_not_in_common_definition.ne.en: Use only the representative chores declared by the protocol
catalog.task_not_in_common_definition.ne.zh: 只用协议声明的代表性杂务

catalog.unknown.price_unknown.en: On sale but the price is unknown: compiled as “data unknown”; clones can see it but cannot buy it; not treated as free
catalog.unknown.price_unknown.zh: 有卖但报价未知：编成“资料未知”，分身看得到但不能购买；不当免费

catalog.unknown.supply_and_price_unknown.en: Both supply and price are unknown: compiled as “data unknown”; clones can see it but cannot buy it; not treated as free
catalog.unknown.supply_and_price_unknown.zh: 供给与报价都未知：编成“资料未知”，分身看得到但不能购买；不当免费

catalog.unknown.supply_unknown.en: Unknown whether this city offers this option (supply unknown): compiled as “data unknown”; clones can see it but cannot buy it
catalog.unknown.supply_unknown.zh: 不知道这座城有没有这项方案（供给未知）：编成“资料未知”，分身看得到但不能购买

datanature.commute_gap.impact.en: Clones in this city cannot use this mode to get to work and can only use the modes in the table; a missing mode is not treated as 0 minutes, nor as free
datanature.commute_gap.impact.zh: 这座城的分身到岗时没有这种方式可用，只能用表里有的方式；缺的方式不当 0 分钟，也不当免费

datanature.commute_gap.message.en: {city}'s commute table has no {mode} (other cities in the comparison group have it)
datanature.commute_gap.message.zh: {city} 的通勤关系表里没有{mode}（比较组里别的城市有）

datanature.commute_gap.next.en: Acknowledge this limitation (the reason is in the scope notes, under what this version does not support)
datanature.commute_gap.next.zh: 知悉这一限制（原因见范围说明里本版不支持的内容）

datanature.scope.commute.text.en: Commuting follows each city's area table: home area × the job's work area × mode → the minutes and cost of one round trip (area-level data or estimates, not route simulation). Each month the available mode with the fewest round-trip minutes is used, with ties going to the cheaper one; driving requires car access in use that month (a separate opportunity paid monthly). Lines or modes not in the table cannot be used and are not treated as 0 minutes; parking and tolls are not modeled
datanature.scope.commute.text.zh: 通勤按每座城的片区关系表执行：住处片区 × 岗位的就业片区 × 方式 → 一次往返的分钟与花费（片区级资料或估计，不是路线模拟）。每个月在可用的方式里取往返最少的一种，分钟相同取花费低的；开车要这个月有在用的用车权（另一项按月付费的机会）。关系表里没有的线或方式不能走，不当 0 分钟；停车与过路费没有建模

datanature.scope.menus.text.en: The {names} shown to clones each year are not the whole catalog but a frozen sampled menu (one per category, year and environment repeat; clones in the same city, year and environment repeat see the same menu, and neither the sampling method nor the seed involves clone IDs). A menu is a chance to apply, not a completed deal or a hire. The current home can be renewed, the current job can continue, and the minimum-living fallback is always available; choices outside the menu are rejected by the plan check
datanature.scope.menus.text.zh: 每年给分身看的{names}不是整个目录，而是一份冻结的抽样菜单（每类、每年、每个环境重复一份；同城、同年、同一环境重复的分身看同一份，抽法与种子里没有分身编号）。菜单是接触机会，不是成交或录用。现住的房子可以续租、现在的岗位可以延续，最低生活的保底方案总在；菜单外的选择会被计划检查拒绝

datanature.scope.occupations.text.en: This data pack supports {n} occupations (a controlled vocabulary; each maps internally to one occupation classification: {schemes}). Occupations outside the vocabulary are rejected at review with the reason given, and the system does not switch to another occupation; if a city's catalog has no job for your occupation, that city reports an error instead of switching jobs automatically. Degrees, certificates or experience a job requires count only if you confirm them explicitly in the qualifications section; titles and free text grant no qualification
datanature.scope.occupations.text.zh: 这份资料包支持 {n} 种职业（受控词表；每种在内部对应一个职业分类：{schemes}）。词表外的职业在审阅时就会被拒绝并说明原因，系统不换成别的职业；某座城的目录里没有你这一职业的岗位时，那座城报错，不自动换岗。岗位要求的学历、证书或经验只认你在资格一栏明确确认的，职称与自由文字都不授予资格

datanature.scope.safety.text.en: Each metro area has one safety background (the same for every home area in the city), derived from the metro's 2024 rates of reported violent and property crime per population; the higher the crime rate, the lower the background. It is a statistical proxy, not a person's probability of experiencing crime or injury; it does not vary with home area or travel mode, and the simulation does not draw crime events. The leisure background is a registered setting shared by the six cities (a small baseline that comes with living in a city); most leisure comes from activities actually attended
datanature.scope.safety.text.zh: 每个都会区一个治安背景（城内所有居住片区相同），由这个都会区 2024 年暴力犯罪与财产犯罪的报案人口发生率得到，犯罪率越高背景越低。它是统计代理，不是个人遭遇犯罪或伤亡的概率；不随住处片区或交通方式变化，模拟里也不抽犯罪事件。休闲背景是六城共同的登记设定（住在城里就有的少量基本条件），主要的休闲来自实际参加的活动

datanature.scope.safety.title.en: Where the safety background comes from

datanature.scope.safety_city.text.en: {city}: {scope}. {coverage}. {residence}. 2024 rates per 100,000 people: violent crime {violent}, property crime {property} (reported offenses, not all crime that occurred)
datanature.scope.safety_city.text.zh: {city}：{scope}。{coverage}。{residence}。2024 年每 10 万人暴力犯罪 {violent}、财产犯罪 {property}（报案数，不是全部发生的犯罪）

datanature.scope.tax.official.en: Tax is withheld monthly under the official 2024 rules (on year-to-date wages), and all {years} simulated years use the 2024 rules; only single filers with wage income only and the standard deduction are supported. Supported residence and workplace: {residence}. The {n} items that are not modeled are listed one by one in this city's data nature (data_nature.tax); they make results differ from a real tax bill
datanature.scope.tax.official.zh: 按官方 2024 年规则逐月预扣（按全年累计工资），模拟的 {years} 年都用 2024 年规则；只支持单身、只有工资收入、按标准扣除。支持的居住与工作地：{residence}。没有建模的 {n} 项逐条列在这座城的资料性质（data_nature.tax）里——它们让结果与真实税单有差别

datanature.scope.tax.synthetic.en: This city's tax is a synthetic test double, not real tax
datanature.scope.tax.synthetic.zh: 这座城的税是合成测试替身，不是真实税

datanature.summary.real.en: {city}: of the {n} opportunities in the catalog, {observed} are observed, {derived} derived, {estimated} estimated and {synthetic} synthetic settings. City data comes from public sources and registered model settings; life rules, scoring and evaluation parameters are synthetic exploratory settings, and real cities are not ranked by them
datanature.summary.real.zh: {city}：目录 {n} 项机会里，观测 {observed}、派生 {derived}、估计 {estimated}、合成设定 {synthetic}。城市资料来自公开来源与登记的模型设定；生活规则、评分与评价参数是合成探索设定，不据此排序真实城市

datanature.summary.synthetic.en: {city}: synthetic data pack; all {n} opportunities in the catalog are hand-made synthetic model settings or test data, not real city data
datanature.summary.synthetic.zh: {city}：合成资料包，目录 {n} 项机会全部是手工合成的模型设定或测试资料，不是真实城市资料

deletion.all.note.en: Your drafts, reviews, confirmations and all runs are being deleted: running simulations get no new model requests and their content is cleared once they wind down; reviews or confirmations that had started but not finished will not be written back. Your personal link still works
deletion.all.note.zh: 你的草稿、审阅、确认与全部运行都在删除：运行中的模拟不再批准新的模型请求，收尾后清掉内容；之前已经开始、还没有完成的审阅或确认不会再写回。专属链接仍然有效

deletion.kept.cost.en: A minimal cost summary (amounts whose sending is uncertain are kept as they are, not set to 0)
deletion.kept.cost.zh: 必要的费用摘要（发送不确定的金额照原样保留，不改成 0）

deletion.kept.identity.en: An opaque service identity and the run IDs
deletion.kept.identity.zh: 不透明的服务身份与运行编号

deletion.kept.quota.en: The record of runs used (deleting does not reset the count)
deletion.kept.quota.zh: 使用次数的记录（删除不会重置次数）

deletion.kept.tombstone.en: The deletion time and a record that keeps old requests from coming back
deletion.kept.tombstone.zh: 删除时间与防止旧请求复活的记录

deletion.run.note.en: This run can no longer be viewed and is winding down safely: no new model requests are approved; requests already sent may finish and be billed (they cannot be recalled); its content is cleared afterwards
deletion.run.note.zh: 这次运行已经不能查看，正在安全收尾：不再批准新的模型请求，已经发出的请求可能完成并记账（不能撤回），收尾后清掉内容

error.cancel_not_allowed.impact.en: Nothing was cancelled; the 1 run already used is not refunded, and existing progress and results stay as they are
error.cancel_not_allowed.impact.zh: 没有取消；已经用掉的 1 次机会不退，已有的进度与结果保持不变

error.cancel_not_allowed.message.en: This run has already started, so it cannot be withdrawn with “cancel before start”
error.cancel_not_allowed.message.zh: 这次运行已经开始过，不能按“开始前取消”撤回

error.cancel_not_allowed.next.en: You can let it continue, or delete this run using the action on the page
error.cancel_not_allowed.next.zh: 可以等它接着运行，或者按页面上的动作删除这次运行

error.csrf_failed.message.en: The request is missing the page check code, or it is wrong
error.csrf_failed.message.zh: 请求缺少或带错了页面校验码

error.csrf_failed.next.en: Refresh the page and try again

error.data_pack_unavailable.impact.en: No simulation was started and no run was used
error.data_pack_unavailable.impact.zh: 没有开始模拟，也没有使用次数

error.data_pack_unavailable.message.en: The city data pack this run needs is unavailable right now, or differs from the recorded version
error.data_pack_unavailable.message.zh: 运行需要的城市资料包现在不可用或与记录的版本不同

error.data_pack_unavailable.next.en: Try again later; the maintainer will check the data pack
error.data_pack_unavailable.next.zh: 稍后再试；维护者会核对资料包

error.deleted.impact.en: The content can no longer be viewed or restored; deleting does not reset the number of runs used
error.deleted.impact.zh: 内容不能再查看或恢复；删除不会重置使用次数

error.deleted.next.en: Create it again if you need it

error.deleting.impact.en: The content can no longer be viewed and is being wound down safely
error.deleting.impact.zh: 内容已经不可查看，正在安全收尾

error.deleting.next.en: Refresh later; it cannot be restored once deletion completes
error.deleting.next.zh: 稍后刷新；删除完成后不能恢复

error.expired.draft.impact.en: A draft is kept for the period in the service rules from its last edit, and viewing does not extend it; it can no longer be read, reviewed or confirmed
error.expired.draft.impact.zh: 草稿从最后一次编辑起按服务规则保存，查看不续期；内容已经不能读取、审阅或确认

error.expired.draft.message.en: This draft is past its retention period
error.expired.draft.message.zh: 这份草稿已经超过保存期限

error.expired.draft.next.en: Start a new draft and fill it in again
error.expired.draft.next.zh: 新建一份草稿重新填写

error.expired.impact.en: The content can no longer be viewed or used; viewing or refreshing does not extend it
error.expired.impact.zh: 内容已经不能查看或使用；查看、刷新都不续期

error.expired.intent.impact.en: A preparation that is awaiting confirmation, blocked by the pre-run check, paused or queued is kept for the period in the service rules from its last real action, and viewing does not extend it; nothing was started or continued, and no run was used
error.expired.intent.impact.zh: 等待确认、检查没通过、暂停或排队的准备从最后一次有效操作起按服务规则保存，查看不续期；没有开始或继续，也没有使用次数

error.expired.intent.message.en: This simulation preparation is past its retention period
error.expired.intent.message.zh: 这次模拟的准备已经超过保存期限

error.expired.intent.next.en: Prepare the simulation again if you need it
error.expired.intent.next.zh: 需要的话重新准备一次模拟

error.expired.message.en: This content is past its retention period
error.expired.message.zh: 这项内容已经超过保存期限

error.expired.next.en: Create it again if you need it

error.expired.profile.impact.en: A confirmed profile can prepare new simulations for the period in the service rules from its first confirmation; confirming again or viewing does not extend it; simulations already prepared use their own copy and deadline and are not affected
error.expired.profile.impact.zh: 确认画像从首次确认起按服务规则可用，重复确认、查看都不续期；已经准备的模拟用自己的副本与期限，不受影响

error.expired.profile.message.en: This confirmed profile can no longer be used to prepare new simulations
error.expired.profile.message.zh: 这份确认画像已经超过可以准备新模拟的期限

error.expired.profile.next.en: Review and confirm a draft that is still within its retention period, or start a new draft
error.expired.profile.next.zh: 重新审阅并确认还在保存期内的草稿，或新建草稿

error.expired.result.impact.en: Results are kept for the period in the service rules from the run's first finish, and viewing does not extend it; the content can no longer be viewed
error.expired.result.impact.zh: 结果从运行首次结束起按服务规则保存，查看不续期；内容已经不能查看

error.expired.result.message.en: This run's results are past their retention period
error.expired.result.message.zh: 这次运行的结果已经超过保存期限

error.expired.result.next.en: Prepare a new simulation if you need it
error.expired.result.next.zh: 需要的话重新准备一次模拟

error.expired.review.impact.en: A review expires together with its draft and can no longer be used to confirm a profile
error.expired.review.impact.zh: 审阅跟着它的草稿一起到期，不能再用来确认画像

error.expired.review.message.en: The draft this review belongs to is past its retention period
error.expired.review.message.zh: 这份审阅所属的草稿已经超过保存期限

error.expired.review.next.en: Start a new draft, fill it in and review it
error.expired.review.next.zh: 新建一份草稿重新填写并审阅

error.idempotency_conflict.impact.en: This request was not carried out

error.idempotency_conflict.message.en: This request ID has already been used for a different request
error.idempotency_conflict.message.zh: 这个请求编号已经用于另一份不同的请求

error.idempotency_conflict.next.en: Generate a new request ID for a new request; when resending the same request, keep its content unchanged
error.idempotency_conflict.next.zh: 为新的请求生成新的请求编号；重发同一个请求时请保持内容不变

error.intent_conflict.impact.en: No new run intent was created
error.intent_conflict.impact.zh: 没有创建新的运行意图

error.intent_conflict.message.en: You already have a simulation being prepared or in progress, with different conditions
error.intent_conflict.message.zh: 你已经有一次正在准备或进行中的模拟，条件与这次不同

error.intent_conflict.next.en: Finish, cancel or delete that one first, then start with the new conditions
error.intent_conflict.next.zh: 先完成、取消或删除那一次，再用新的条件开始

error.internal_error.message.en: The service hit an internal problem

error.internal_error.next.en: Try again later; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference
error.internal_error.next.zh: 稍后再试；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

error.invalid_request.impact.en: This request was not carried out

error.invalid_request.message.en: The request's format or content does not meet the requirements
error.invalid_request.message.zh: 请求的格式或内容不符合要求

error.invalid_request.next.en: Check what you entered on the page; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference
error.invalid_request.next.zh: 检查页面上的填写；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

error.migration_choice_required.impact.en: The draft was not changed; the system does not reinterpret the old percentages as ratings
error.migration_choice_required.impact.zh: 草稿没有改动；系统不把旧百分比改读成评分

error.migration_choice_required.message.en: This old draft's six-dimension / material allocation uses the old questionnaire's percentages; choose to re-rate or to weight everything equally before migrating
error.migration_choice_required.message.zh: 这份旧草稿的六维 / 物质分配是旧问卷的百分比，迁移时要先选择重新评分或同等重视

error.migration_choice_required.next.en: Look at the original allocation in the migration notes, then choose re-rate or equal weight and migrate
error.migration_choice_required.next.zh: 先看迁移说明里原来的分配，再选择重新评分或同等重视后迁移

error.migration_consent_required.impact.en: The draft was not changed, and the new questionnaire cannot use it yet
error.migration_consent_required.impact.zh: 草稿没有改动，新问卷还不能用它

error.migration_consent_required.message.en: This old draft has answers the new questionnaire no longer collects; migrating clears them, and you have not agreed to that yet
error.migration_consent_required.message.zh: 这份旧草稿里有新问卷不再收集的答案，迁移会清空它们，还没有得到你的同意

error.migration_consent_required.next.en: Read the draft's migration notes first; migrate after you agree to clear those old answers
error.migration_consent_required.next.zh: 先看草稿的迁移说明；同意清空那些旧答案后再迁移

error.migration_not_needed.message.en: This draft already uses the current questionnaire version; there is nothing to migrate
error.migration_not_needed.message.zh: 这份草稿已经是当前的问卷版本，没有要迁移的内容

error.not_found.impact.en: This ID does not exist in your space (it may also have expired or been deleted)
error.not_found.impact.zh: 这个编号在你的空间里不存在（也可能已经过期或删除）

error.not_found.next.en: Go back to “My runs” or create it again
error.not_found.next.zh: 回到“我的运行”或重新创建

error.not_resumable.impact.en: No new model request was sent and the run was not changed
error.not_resumable.impact.zh: 没有发出新的模型请求，也没有改变运行

error.not_resumable.message.en: You cannot resume this run right now
error.not_resumable.message.zh: 这次运行现在不能由你恢复

error.not_resumable.next.en: If the page says it is waiting for the maintainer, you do not need to fill anything in again; otherwise check the run's status
error.not_resumable.next.zh: 如果页面说在等维护者处理，你不需要重新填写；否则查看运行状态

error.origin_rejected.message.en: The request was not sent from this site's pages
error.origin_rejected.message.zh: 请求不是从本站页面发出的

error.origin_rejected.next.en: Do it again from this site's pages

error.paid_calls_disabled.impact.en: A simulation that needs a real model cannot start, and the system will not quietly switch to the offline planner
error.paid_calls_disabled.impact.zh: 不能开始需要真实模型的模拟，系统不会悄悄换成离线规划器

error.paid_calls_disabled.message.en: The service has not turned on paid model calls
error.paid_calls_disabled.message.zh: 服务现在没有开启付费模型调用

error.paid_calls_disabled.next.en: Try again after the service turns them on; no run was used
error.paid_calls_disabled.next.zh: 等服务开启后再试；没有使用次数

error.payload_too_large.impact.en: This request was not carried out

error.payload_too_large.next.en: Shorten what you entered and try again

error.preflight_stale.impact.en: No simulation was started and no run was used
error.preflight_stale.impact.zh: 没有开始模拟，也没有使用次数

error.preflight_stale.message.en: What you confirmed is not the current pre-run summary (the conditions or data changed, or the summary was updated)
error.preflight_stale.message.zh: 你确认的不是当前这一份运行前说明（条件或资料变了，或说明已经更新）

error.preflight_stale.next.en: Read the latest pre-run summary, then confirm again
error.preflight_stale.next.zh: 查看最新的运行前说明后再确认

error.quota_exhausted.impact.en: No new simulation can be started

error.quota_exhausted.message.en: This space's 3 simulation runs are used up or all in use
error.quota_exhausted.message.zh: 这个空间的 3 次模拟机会已经用完或都在使用中

error.quota_exhausted.next.en: Look at the results you already have; the count does not reset automatically
error.quota_exhausted.next.zh: 查看已有的运行结果；次数不会自动重置

error.rate_limited.impact.en: This request was not carried out

error.rate_limited.next.en: Wait a minute and try again

error.result_unavailable.impact.en: There are no results before the start, after cancelling, while running or when stopped; nothing is made up when there are none
error.result_unavailable.impact.zh: 还没有开始、已经取消、运行中或停下时没有结果；没有就不编一个

error.result_unavailable.message.en: This run has no progress or results to view right now
error.result_unavailable.message.zh: 这次运行现在没有可以查看的进度或结果

error.result_unavailable.next.en: Check this run's status; come back for the results after it ends
error.result_unavailable.next.zh: 查看这次运行的状态；结束后再来看结果

error.revision_conflict.impact.en: This save was not written, and the newer answers were not overwritten
error.revision_conflict.impact.zh: 这次保存没有写入，较新的答案没有被覆盖

error.revision_conflict.message.en: A newer version of this draft has already been saved elsewhere (for example in another tab)
error.revision_conflict.message.zh: 这份草稿已经在别处（例如另一个标签页）保存了更新的版本

error.revision_conflict.next.en: Reload the latest draft, make your changes on top of it, then save
error.revision_conflict.next.zh: 重新读取最新的草稿，在它的基础上修改后再保存

error.run_options_invalid.impact.en: No simulation was prepared and no run was used (field names which option)
error.run_options_invalid.impact.zh: 没有准备模拟，也没有使用次数（field 指出是哪一项）

error.run_options_invalid.message.en: The cities, clones per city, years or cost cap chosen this time are outside what the service allows
error.run_options_invalid.message.zh: 这次选的城市、每城分身数、年数或费用上限不在服务允许的范围里

error.run_options_invalid.next.en: Choose again within the defaults and ranges in the service rules; cities are changed in the draft, followed by a new review and confirmation
error.run_options_invalid.next.zh: 按服务规则里的默认值与允许范围重新选择；城市要在草稿里改，再重新审阅与确认

error.run_settings_unavailable.impact.en: The system will not continue with the service's current defaults instead; nothing was started and no run was used
error.run_settings_unavailable.impact.zh: 系统不会改用服务现在的默认设置继续，没有开始，也没有使用次数

error.run_settings_unavailable.message.en: The settings saved for this run, or its copy of the confirmed profile, are missing or damaged
error.run_settings_unavailable.message.zh: 这次运行保存的设置或确认画像副本缺失、损坏

error.run_settings_unavailable.next.en: Cancel this preparation and prepare again; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference
error.run_settings_unavailable.next.zh: 取消这次准备后重新准备；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

error.start_acknowledgement_missing.impa.en: Nothing started and no run was used
error.start_acknowledgement_missing.impa.zh: 没有开始，也没有使用次数

error.start_acknowledgement_missing.mess.en: Not all of the things to acknowledge before starting were confirmed
error.start_acknowledgement_missing.mess.zh: 开始之前要知悉的事项没有全部确认

error.start_acknowledgement_missing.next.en: Read every item in the settings preview, tick them all, then confirm and start
error.start_acknowledgement_missing.next.zh: 看过设置预览里的每一项、全部勾选之后再确认并开始

error.start_already_authorized.impact.en: Nothing was started twice and no extra run was used
error.start_already_authorized.impact.zh: 没有重复开始，也没有多用次数

error.start_already_authorized.message.en: This preparation already carries your “confirm and start”: the service starts it automatically once the check passes, so no further confirmation is needed
error.start_already_authorized.message.zh: 这次准备已经带着你的“确认并开始”：检查通过后由服务自动开始，不需要再确认

error.start_already_authorized.next.en: Wait for the progress; if the start authorization stops being valid, the page offers a way to confirm and start again
error.start_already_authorized.next.zh: 等待进度；开始授权作废时，页面会给出重新确认并开始的入口

error.start_consent_stale.impact.en: Nothing started and no run was used
error.start_consent_stale.impact.zh: 没有开始，也没有使用次数

error.start_consent_stale.message.en: What you confirmed is not the current settings preview (the data, quote, scale, cost cap or the things to acknowledge changed)
error.start_consent_stale.message.zh: 你确认的不是当前这一份设置预览（资料、报价、规模、费用上限或要知悉的事项变了）

error.start_consent_stale.next.en: Get a new settings preview, read it, then confirm and start
error.start_consent_stale.next.zh: 重新取一份设置预览，看过之后再确认并开始

error.unauthenticated.impact.en: Nothing in this space can be read or changed
error.unauthenticated.impact.zh: 不能读取或修改这个空间里的任何内容

error.unauthenticated.message.en: There is no valid session, or your personal link is no longer valid
error.unauthenticated.message.zh: 没有有效的会话，或专属链接已经失效

error.unauthenticated.next.en: Open your personal link again; if the link was reissued, use the newest one
error.unauthenticated.next.zh: 重新打开你的专属链接；如果链接被重发过，请使用最新的那一个

explain.after_impact.archive_conflict.en: The original records were not changed

explain.after_impact.attempts_exhausted.en: This plan will not send requests again on its own, and attempt counts are not reset nor a new ledger opened
explain.after_impact.attempts_exhausted.zh: 这份规划不会自动再发请求，也不会重置尝试次数或另开账本

explain.after_impact.budget_blocked.en: The budget is not topped up automatically; what has already finished is kept
explain.after_impact.budget_blocked.zh: 不会自动追加预算；已经完成的部分保留

explain.after_impact.credentials_missing.en: No new request was sent, and it will not switch to the offline planner
explain.after_impact.credentials_missing.zh: 没有发出新的请求，也不会换成离线规划器

explain.after_impact.model_mismatch.en: That reply is not used for planning; the model is not switched automatically
explain.after_impact.model_mismatch.zh: 那份回复不用于规划；不自动换模型

explain.after_impact.paid_calls_disabled.en: The system will not quietly switch to the offline planner to continue
explain.after_impact.paid_calls_disabled.zh: 系统不会悄悄换成离线规划器继续

explain.after_impact.queued_resume.en: Resuming does not use another run; replies already saved are not requested again
explain.after_impact.queued_resume.zh: 恢复不另扣次数；已经保存的回复不会重新请求

explain.after_impact.service_unavailable.en: Replies already saved will not be requested again
explain.after_impact.service_unavailable.zh: 已经保存的回复不会重新请求

explain.after_impact.snapshot_broken.en: The system will not use new data in place of the old data to continue
explain.after_impact.snapshot_broken.zh: 系统不会拿新资料冒充旧资料继续

explain.after_impact.uncertain_send.en: To avoid paying twice, it is not resent automatically; this request's reserved cost is kept as it is
explain.after_impact.uncertain_send.zh: 为了不重复付费，不自动重发；这次的预留费用照原样保留

explain.after_next.maintainer.en: You do not need to fill anything in again: wait for the maintainer, or delete this run; no resume button that would not work is offered
explain.after_next.maintainer.zh: 不需要重新填写：等维护者处理，或删除这次运行；不会提供无效的“恢复”

explain.after_next.queued_resume.en: No action needed: the service will continue it in order; a run that has already started cannot be withdrawn with “cancel before start”, but you can delete it if you need to
explain.after_next.queued_resume.zh: 不需要操作：服务会按顺序接着运行；已经开始过的运行不能按“开始前取消”撤回，需要的话可以删除

explain.after_next.resumable.en: Click “Resume” later to continue the same run (no extra run is used)
explain.after_next.resumable.zh: 稍后点“恢复”继续同一次运行（不另扣次数）

explain.after_start.lead.en: The simulation has started, and this run has used 1 of your runs (not refunded once started)
explain.after_start.lead.zh: 模拟已经开始，这次运行已经用掉 1 次机会（开始之后不退）

explain.before_impact.credentials_missin.en: No request was sent, and it will not switch to the offline planner
explain.before_impact.credentials_missin.zh: 没有发出任何请求，也不会换成离线规划器

explain.before_impact.model_mismatch.en: No reply was used for planning

explain.before_impact.paid_calls_disable.en: The system will not quietly switch to the offline planner
explain.before_impact.paid_calls_disable.zh: 系统不会悄悄换成离线规划器

explain.before_impact.paid_calls_off_wai.en: The system will not quietly switch to the offline planner
explain.before_impact.paid_calls_off_wai.zh: 系统不会悄悄换成离线规划器

explain.before_impact.request_too_large.en: No request was sent; the system will not trim options or switch models
explain.before_impact.request_too_large.zh: 没有发出请求；系统不会删减选项或换模型

explain.before_impact.snapshot_broken.en: The system will not use new data in place of the old data
explain.before_impact.snapshot_broken.zh: 系统不会拿新资料冒充旧资料

explain.before_impact.start_authorizatio.en: It will not start on the earlier consent
explain.before_impact.start_authorizatio.zh: 不会按原来的同意开始

explain.before_impact.start_conditions_c.en: The service checks again under the new conditions and will not start on the earlier consent
explain.before_impact.start_conditions_c.zh: 服务按新的条件重新检查，不会按原来的同意开始

explain.before_impact.start_consent_chan.en: It will not start on the earlier consent
explain.before_impact.start_consent_chan.zh: 不会按原来的同意开始

explain.before_impact.start_data_pack_un.en: The system will not substitute other data, and will not start on the earlier consent
explain.before_impact.start_data_pack_un.zh: 系统不会拿别的资料冒充，也不会按原来的同意开始

explain.before_impact.start_internal_err.en: It will not retry automatically, and will not start on the earlier consent
explain.before_impact.start_internal_err.zh: 不会自动重试，也不会按原来的同意开始

explain.before_impact.start_paid_calls_d.en: The system will not quietly switch to the offline planner, and will not start automatically once calls are enabled
explain.before_impact.start_paid_calls_d.zh: 系统不会悄悄换成离线规划器，也不会在开启之后自动开始

explain.before_impact.start_quota_exhaus.en: It will not start on the earlier consent
explain.before_impact.start_quota_exhaus.zh: 不会按原来的同意开始

explain.before_lead.queued_first_start.en: The simulation has not started yet; 1 run is reserved and only becomes used at the first start; cancelling before the start returns it
explain.before_lead.queued_first_start.zh: 还没有开始模拟；预留了 1 次机会，首次启动时才转为已使用，开始之前取消会退回

explain.before_lead.released.en: No simulation was started, and the reserved run has been returned
explain.before_lead.released.zh: 没有开始模拟，预留的次数已经退回

explain.before_lead.unused.en: No simulation was started, and no run was used
explain.before_lead.unused.zh: 没有开始模拟，没有使用次数

explain.before_next.credentials_missing.en: After the maintainer fixes it, cancel this preparation and prepare again
explain.before_next.credentials_missing.zh: 等维护者处理后，取消这次准备并重新准备

explain.before_next.default.en: Cancel this preparation and prepare again; if it keeps happening, contact the maintainer with the support reference
explain.before_next.default.zh: 取消这次准备后重新准备；问题一直出现时请联系维护者并提供支持编号

explain.before_next.options_not_allowed.en: Cancel this preparation and prepare again within the ranges the service rules now allow
explain.before_next.options_not_allowed.zh: 取消这次准备，按服务规则里现在允许的范围重新准备

explain.before_next.paid_calls_disabled.en: After the service turns them on, cancel this preparation and prepare again
explain.before_next.paid_calls_disabled.zh: 等服务开启后，取消这次准备并重新准备

explain.before_next.paid_calls_off_waiti.en: Once the maintainer turns them on, the page will show “Confirm start”; you do not need to fill anything in again, and you can also cancel this preparation first
explain.before_next.paid_calls_off_waiti.zh: 等维护者开启后，页面会出现“确认开始”；不需要重新填写，也可以先取消这次准备

explain.before_next.preflight_blocked.en: Change your answers as described, review and confirm the profile again, then prepare again
explain.before_next.preflight_blocked.zh: 按说明修改答案，重新审阅、确认画像后再准备一次

explain.before_next.queued_first_start.en: No action needed: the service will start it in order; you can also cancel before it starts
explain.before_next.queued_first_start.zh: 不需要操作：服务会按顺序开始；开始之前也可以取消

explain.before_next.request_too_large.en: After the maintainer adjusts it, cancel this preparation and prepare again
explain.before_next.request_too_large.zh: 等维护者调整后，取消这次准备并重新准备

explain.before_next.start_authorization_.en: Confirm and start again, or cancel this preparation; if the problem keeps happening, contact the maintainer
explain.before_next.start_authorization_.zh: 重新确认并开始，或取消这次准备；问题一直出现时请联系维护者

explain.before_next.start_conditions_cha.en: After reading the new pre-run notes, confirm and start again; you can also cancel this preparation
explain.before_next.start_conditions_cha.zh: 看过新的运行前说明后重新确认并开始；也可以取消这次准备

explain.before_next.start_consent_change.en: After reading the new notes, confirm and start again; you can also cancel this preparation
explain.before_next.start_consent_change.zh: 看过新的说明后重新确认并开始；也可以取消这次准备

explain.before_next.start_data_pack_unav.en: Cancel this preparation and prepare again; if the problem keeps happening, contact the maintainer
explain.before_next.start_data_pack_unav.zh: 取消这次准备后重新准备；问题一直出现时请联系维护者

explain.before_next.start_internal_error.en: Confirm and start again, or cancel this preparation; if the problem keeps happening, contact the maintainer
explain.before_next.start_internal_error.zh: 重新确认并开始，或取消这次准备；问题一直出现时请联系维护者

explain.before_next.start_paid_calls_dis.en: Once the service enables them, confirm and start again; there is nothing to fill in again, and you can also cancel this preparation first
explain.before_next.start_paid_calls_dis.zh: 等服务开启后重新确认并开始；不需要重新填写，也可以先取消这次准备

explain.before_next.start_quota_exhauste.en: Cancel this preparation; simulation runs are not topped up automatically
explain.before_next.start_quota_exhauste.zh: 取消这次准备；启动机会不会自动增加

explain.reason.archive_conflict.en: The run records do not match the inputs they are bound to
explain.reason.archive_conflict.zh: 运行记录与绑定的输入对不上

explain.reason.attempts_exhausted.en: The model service is temporarily unavailable, and the service attempts for this plan are used up
explain.reason.attempts_exhausted.zh: 模型服务暂时不可用，这一份规划的服务尝试次数已经用完

explain.reason.budget_blocked.en: This run's cost cap or request limit is not enough to send the next request
explain.reason.budget_blocked.zh: 这次运行的费用上限或请求次数上限不够发出下一次请求

explain.reason.credentials_missing.en: The real model's credentials are unavailable right now
explain.reason.credentials_missing.zh: 真实模型的凭证现在不可用

explain.reason.inputs_changed.en: The last check after confirming and before starting found that the run conditions changed
explain.reason.inputs_changed.zh: 确认开始之后、启动之前的最后核对发现运行条件变了

explain.reason.internal_error.en: The service hit an internal problem

explain.reason.model_mismatch.en: The model service's model does not match the setting
explain.reason.model_mismatch.zh: 模型服务的型号与设定不符

explain.reason.options_not_allowed.en: The service's allowed ranges changed, so the scale or cost cap chosen this time can no longer be used
explain.reason.options_not_allowed.zh: 服务的允许范围变了，这次选的规模或费用上限已经不能用

explain.reason.paid_calls_disabled.en: The service has not turned on paid model calls
explain.reason.paid_calls_disabled.zh: 服务现在没有开启付费模型调用

explain.reason.paid_calls_off_waiting.en: This simulation needs a real model, and the service has not turned on paid model calls
explain.reason.paid_calls_off_waiting.zh: 这次模拟需要真实模型，服务现在没有开启付费模型调用

explain.reason.preflight_blocked.en: The pre-run check did not pass (the reasons are listed one by one in the pre-run summary)
explain.reason.preflight_blocked.zh: 运行前检查没有通过（原因逐条写在运行前说明里）

explain.reason.queued_first_start.en: Start confirmed; waiting in the queue for the first start
explain.reason.queued_first_start.zh: 已经确认开始，正在排队等待首次启动

explain.reason.queued_resume.en: This run has already started and is waiting in the queue to resume
explain.reason.queued_resume.zh: 这次运行已经开始过，正在排队等待恢复

explain.reason.reference_stale.en: The confirmed profile or this run's settings did not match during the check
explain.reason.reference_stale.zh: 确认的画像或这次的运行设置在检查时对不上

explain.reason.request_too_large.en: A first-year planning request is over the planner's single-request input limit
explain.reason.request_too_large.zh: 首年规划请求超过规划器的单次输入上限

explain.reason.result_unavailable.en: The simulation has ended, but the results cannot be read right now
explain.reason.result_unavailable.zh: 模拟已结束，但结果暂时无法读取

explain.reason.run_binding_conflict.en: The run found does not match the run registered for this confirmation
explain.reason.run_binding_conflict.zh: 找到的运行与这次确认登记的运行不一致

explain.reason.run_halted.en: The simulation stopped under E1's rules
explain.reason.run_halted.zh: 模拟按 E1 的规则停下

explain.reason.run_partially_initialized.en: The run folder was only half created at start (the process was interrupted)
explain.reason.run_partially_initialized.zh: 运行目录在启动时只建了一半（进程中断）

explain.reason.service_unavailable.en: The model service is temporarily unavailable, so the simulation paused, as the rules allow, at a year boundary or between two candidate plans
explain.reason.service_unavailable.zh: 模型服务暂时不可用，模拟按规则在年度边界或两份候选之间停下

explain.reason.settings_missing.en: The settings saved for this run are missing or damaged
explain.reason.settings_missing.zh: 这次运行保存的设置缺失或损坏

explain.reason.snapshot_broken.en: The data snapshot this simulation is bound to is missing or was changed
explain.reason.snapshot_broken.zh: 这次模拟绑定的资料快照缺失或被改动

explain.reason.start_authorization_misma.en: The settings found by the check do not match the ones you confirmed, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_authorization_misma.zh: 检查出来的设置与你确认开始的那一份对不上，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_conditions_changed.en: After you confirmed the start, the data pack, planner, quote or settings changed, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_conditions_changed.zh: 你确认开始之后，资料包、规划器、报价或这次的设置变了，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_consent_changed.en: After you confirmed the start, the scope notes you must acknowledge changed, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_consent_changed.zh: 你确认开始之后，这次开始要知悉的范围说明变了，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_data_pack_unavailab.en: The data this simulation is bound to could not be read before starting, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_data_pack_unavailab.zh: 开始之前读不到这次模拟绑定的资料，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_internal_error.en: The service hit an internal problem while starting as you confirmed, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_internal_error.zh: 按你的确认开始时服务出现了内部问题，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_paid_calls_disabled.en: When the check passed, paid model calls were not enabled, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_paid_calls_disabled.zh: 检查通过时服务没有开启付费模型调用，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_quota_exhausted.en: When the check passed, no simulation runs were left, so the earlier start authorization no longer applies
explain.reason.start_quota_exhausted.zh: 检查通过时已经没有可用的启动机会，原来的开始授权作废

explain.reason.start_refused.en: The last check before starting did not pass
explain.reason.start_refused.zh: 启动前的最后核对没有通过

explain.reason.uncertain_send.en: Whether one model request was already sent cannot be confirmed
explain.reason.uncertain_send.zh: 有一次模型请求是否已经发出无法确认

fact.activity.not_done.en: The equipment capability it needs was missing (no equipment in use at home, and no package provided it this time): it did not take place and nothing was charged
fact.activity.not_done.zh: 缺少需要的装备能力（家里没有在用的装备，这次也没有套餐提供）：没有进行，也没有收费

fact.car_access.bought.en: Commuting by car needs car access in use that month (paid monthly); in the months it was in use, trips to the workplace used whichever available mode had the shortest round trip
fact.car_access.bought.zh: 开车通勤要这个月有在用的用车权（按月付费）：用上的月份里，到岗时在可用方式里取往返最少的一种

fact.car_access.not_bought.en: No car access was used this year: driving to work was not possible this year, and trips to the workplace used only the modes in the commute table that do not need car access
fact.car_access.not_bought.zh: 今年没有用上用车权：这一年不能开车通勤，到岗只用通勤关系表里不需要用车权的方式

fact.commute_status.computed.en: Computed from the commute table: from the area of the home actually lived in to the work area of each on-site job, using the available mode with the shortest round trip
fact.commute_status.computed.zh: 按通勤关系表执行：实际住处片区到各个到岗岗位的就业片区，取可用方式里往返最少的一种

fact.commute_status.no_onsite_work.en: No on-site work this month: commuting is zero
fact.commute_status.no_onsite_work.zh: 这个月没有需要到岗的工作：通勤为零

fact.commute_status.unknown_no_housing.en: No housing in the month of the exit: the commute basis is missing, so it is recorded as unknown (not 0)
fact.commute_status.unknown_no_housing.zh: 出局当月没有住房：通勤依据缺失，记为未知（不是 0）

fact.not_made.cancelled_when_ill.en: Cancelled under the annual contingency plan because of illness in the month of purchase: nothing was charged, and it is not postponed or bought later
fact.not_made.cancelled_when_ill.zh: 按年度应急安排，购买那个月生着病就取消：没有扣款，不顺延、不补购

fact.not_made.not_reached.en: Already exited or stopped before that month: it did not happen
fact.not_made.not_reached.zh: 那个月之前已经出局或停止：没有发生

fact.not_made.paused.en: Paused that month because of illness: nothing was bought
fact.not_made.paused.zh: 那个月生病暂停：没有购买

fact.not_made.rejected.en: Not bought: that month it was unaffordable or the plan could not be carried out; nothing was charged and the item was not obtained
fact.not_made.rejected.zh: 没有买成：那个月付不起或计划不可执行；没有扣款，也没有得到这件东西

fact.note.exit.en: Month {month}: could not pay for the minimum housing and food and exited (environment record)
fact.note.exit.zh: 第 {month} 月付不起最低住房与食品而出局（环境记录）

fact.note.stop.en: Month {month}: stopped (not enough contingency arrangements after an illness, or a data gap; a support limit of the simulation, not a life exit)
fact.note.stop.zh: 第 {month} 月停止（疾病之后应急安排不足或资料缺口；模拟的支持边界，不是生活出局）

fact.replacement.bought.en: The replacement declared in advance in the annual plan was bought the next month as a normal purchase
fact.replacement.bought.zh: 按年度计划预先声明的替换，在下个月按普通购买买到

fact.replacement.next_year.en: Broke in month 12: the replacement is left to next year's plan
fact.replacement.next_year.zh: 第 12 月坏的：替换留给下一年的计划

fact.replacement.not_declared.en: The annual plan declared no replacement in advance: after it broke, the item was gone
fact.replacement.not_declared.zh: 年度计划没有预先声明替换：坏了之后就没有这件东西了

fact.replacement.not_reached.en: Already exited or stopped before the replacement month: it did not happen
fact.replacement.not_reached.zh: 替换那个月之前已经出局或停止：没有发生

fact.replacement.rejected.en: A replacement was declared in advance, but the next month it was unaffordable or the plan could not be carried out: not bought, and not postponed
fact.replacement.rejected.zh: 预先声明了替换，但下个月买不起或计划不可执行：没有买成，不顺延

input.ability_duplicated.impact.en: This qualification cannot go into the starting state, and the profile cannot be confirmed
input.ability_duplicated.impact.zh: 这项资格不能进入开局，画像不能确认

input.ability_duplicated.message.en: Qualification {aid} appears {n} times ({states}): the system will not decide for you whether you hold it
input.ability_duplicated.message.zh: 资格 {aid} 出现了 {n} 次（{states}）：系统不替你判断持不持有

input.ability_duplicated.next.en: Keep only one entry: choose “provided” if you hold it, or “not sure yet” if you are not sure
input.ability_duplicated.next.zh: 只保留一条：持有就选“已提供”，不确定就选“暂不确定”

input.ability_unknown.impact.en: This qualification will not go into the starting state
input.ability_unknown.impact.zh: 这项资格不会进入开局

input.ability_unknown.message.en: This version has no definition for qualification {aid}
input.ability_unknown.message.zh: 本版没有资格 {aid} 的定义

input.ability_unknown.next.en: Only confirm qualifications listed in the capability list
input.ability_unknown.next.zh: 只确认能力清单里列出的资格

input.ack.interests_not_personalized.en: Whatever is not personalized by specific interests or taste this time is evaluated with neutral rules (not answered, not sure yet, no fixed hobby and the generic evaluation are each recorded as such); descriptions you wrote that this version does not support are only kept as written
input.ack.interests_not_personalized.zh: 本次不按具体兴趣或口味个性化的部分按中性规则评价（未答、暂不确定、没有固定爱好或通用评价各自记下）；写了但本版不支持的描述只留存原文

input.ack.retained.en: Statement {ref} is not scored and not guaranteed in this version; it is only kept as written
input.ack.retained.zh: 陈述 {ref} 本版不评分、不保证执行，只留存原文

input.ack.standard_start.en: This is a simplified scenario that starts healthy, with no belongings and no courses in progress (real furniture and medical history are not included yet)
input.ack.standard_start.zh: 这是一次从健康、没有已有物品、没有在学课程开始的简化情景（现实中的家具与病史暂未纳入）

input.ack_missing.impact.en: The profile cannot be confirmed until you acknowledge this explanation
input.ack_missing.impact.zh: 没有知悉这项说明就不能确认画像

input.ack_missing.next.en: Read the explanation, then tick to acknowledge it

input.age_missing.impact.en: The starting state needs an age (the model's illness rules go by age band and are not medically calibrated)
input.age_missing.impact.zh: 开局状态需要年龄（模型的疾病规则按年龄段，未经医学标定）

input.age_missing.message.en: Age is not filled in yet

input.age_missing.next.en: Enter your age in whole years at the start of the simulation
input.age_missing.next.zh: 填写模拟开始时的整数年龄

input.age_out_of_range.impact.en: This version only supports scenarios with a single adult
input.age_out_of_range.impact.zh: 本版只支持单个成年人的情景

input.age_out_of_range.message.en: Age {age} is outside the {low}–{high} years this version supports
input.age_out_of_range.message.zh: 年龄 {age} 不在本版支持的 {low}–{high} 岁之间

input.age_out_of_range.next.en: Enter an age within the supported range
input.age_out_of_range.next.zh: 填写支持范围内的年龄

input.allocation.equal_split_with_values.en: It is unclear which split you want
input.allocation.equal_split_with_values.zh: 不能确定你要的是哪一种分配

input.allocation.equal_split_with_values.en: You chose “split equally” and also submitted manual values: only one of the two can be used
input.allocation.equal_split_with_values.zh: 选择了“平均分配”，又提交了手工数值：两者只能选一种

input.allocation.equal_split_with_values.en: Undo the equal split, or clear the manual values
input.allocation.equal_split_with_values.zh: 撤销平均分配，或清空手工数值

input.allocation.healthcare.impact.en: The healthcare points here will not be used, and will not be reinterpreted as health answers
input.allocation.healthcare.impact.zh: 这里的医疗点数不会被使用，也不会被改读成健康回答

input.allocation.healthcare.message.en: Health is not part of the six areas' 100 points: in the new questionnaire, coping with health risks is a separate questionnaire that takes none of these 100 points
input.allocation.healthcare.message.zh: 健康不在六维 100 分里：新问卷的健康风险应对是一份独立问卷，不占这 100 分

input.allocation.healthcare.next.en: Remove this entry and answer in the health questionnaire
input.allocation.healthcare.next.zh: 删掉这一项，在健康问卷里回答

input.allocation.laundry.impact.en: This entry will not be used, and will not be reinterpreted as a new question
input.allocation.laundry.impact.zh: 这一项不会被使用，也不会被改读成新题目

input.allocation.laundry.message.en: “Laundry” in the old questionnaire asked whether you have laundry facilities; it cannot be taken automatically as “daily convenience” (willingness to pay to reduce daily chores)
input.allocation.laundry.message.zh: 旧问卷的“洗衣”问的是有没有洗衣条件，不能自动当作“日常生活便利”（愿意花钱减少日常杂务）

input.allocation.laundry.next.en: Split the four material-life items again under the new questions (living space, food, daily convenience, personal consumption and enjoyment)
input.allocation.laundry.next.zh: 按新题目重新分配物质四项（居住空间、饮食生活、日常生活便利、个人消费与享受）

input.allocation.mode_retired.impact.en: Percentages are not independent ratings, and the system does not reinterpret them as ratings; the profile cannot be confirmed for now
input.allocation.mode_retired.impact.zh: 百分比不是独立评分，系统不把它改读成评分；画像暂时不能确认

input.allocation.mode_retired.message.en: In this version of the questionnaire, {what} uses independent ratings: each item gets 0–100 points and they need not add up to 100; the old percentage allocation cannot be used to confirm
input.allocation.mode_retired.message.zh: 这一版问卷的{what}用独立评分：每项 0–100 分，不必凑满 100；旧的百分比分配不能直接用来确认

input.allocation.mode_retired.next.en: Rate each item again, or choose equal weight (50 points each)
input.allocation.mode_retired.next.zh: 给每一项重新评分，或选择同等重视（每项 50 分）

input.allocation.no_value.impact.en: This item has no usable value
input.allocation.no_value.impact.zh: 这一项没有可用的数值

input.allocation.not_given.impact.en: The split across the {what} is not complete, so it cannot be confirmed

input.allocation.not_given.message.en: {name}: {state}; the system will not turn it into 0 points or an equal share automatically
input.allocation.not_given.message.zh: {name} {state}：系统不会把它自动换成 0 分或平均分

input.allocation.not_given.next.en: Give it an explicit number of points (0 is allowed), or choose to split equally
input.allocation.not_given.next.zh: 给它一个明确的分数（可以是 0），或选择平均分配

input.allocation.out_of_range.next.en: Each item must be between 0 and 100
input.allocation.out_of_range.next.zh: 每一项在 0 到 100 之间

input.allocation.parse_error.next.en: Use a number with at most two decimal places, or split equally
input.allocation.parse_error.next.zh: 改成最多两位小数的数，或使用平均分配

input.allocation.sum_not_100.impact.en: The system will not cut or top up any item proportionally
input.allocation.sum_not_100.impact.zh: 系统不会按比例自动扣减或补齐任何一项

input.allocation.sum_not_100.message.en: The {what} add up to {total} (shown as {shown}), not 100: {gap}

input.allocation.sum_not_100.next.en: You decide which item to move points from and to, until the total is exactly 100
input.allocation.sum_not_100.next.zh: 由你决定从哪一项挪到哪一项，直到精确合计 100

input.allocation.unknown_key.impact.en: This entry will not be used

input.allocation.unknown_key.message.en: “{key}” is not one of the {what} in this version

input.answer_state.leisure.described.mea.en: Candidates are first formed from the vocabulary; only the categories you choose enter the evaluation, and unrecognized descriptions are kept as written and not evaluated in this version
input.answer_state.leisure.described.mea.zh: 先按词表形成候选，你选中的类别才进入评价；没认出的描述原样保留，本版不评价

input.answer_state.leisure.generic.meani.en: Experience whatever suitable activities the city offers (evaluated with the neutral rule)
input.answer_state.leisure.generic.meani.zh: 城市有什么合适的就体验什么（按中性规则评价）

input.answer_state.leisure.selected.mean.en: The categories you pick are used for the evaluation directly; no text is needed
input.answer_state.leisure.selected.mean.zh: 你选中的类别直接用于评价，不需要写文字

input.answer_state.leisure.unanswered.me.en: No clear information for this item: evaluated with the neutral rule, and not treated as choosing the “general evaluation”
input.answer_state.leisure.unanswered.me.zh: 没有这一项的明确信息，按中性规则评价；不会被当成“通用评价”的选择

input.answer_state.taste.described.meani.en: Candidates are first formed from the vocabulary; only the cuisines you choose enter the food evaluation, and brands and other requirements are only kept as written
input.answer_state.taste.described.meani.zh: 先按词表形成候选，你选中的菜系才进入饮食评价；品牌与其他要求只留存

input.answer_state.taste.selected.meanin.en: The cuisines you pick are used for the food evaluation directly; no text is needed
input.answer_state.taste.selected.meanin.zh: 你选中的菜系直接用于饮食评价，不需要写文字

input.capabilities.money_input_rule.en: Amounts are accepted in only two forms: an ungrouped non-negative decimal (for example 3000.50), or thousands grouped strictly in threes (for example 3,000.50); the decimal point must be “.”, with at most two decimal places. Forms such as “3000,50”, “3,,000” or “1,23.45” are rejected; the system does not guess what you meant
input.capabilities.money_input_rule.zh: 金额只接受两种写法：不分组的非负十进制（例如 3000.50），或严格每三位一组的千分位（例如 3,000.50）；小数点只能用“.”，最多两位小数。“3000,50”“3,,000”“1,23.45”这类写法会被拒绝，系统不猜你的意思

input.capabilities.occupation_note.en: Describe your work in your own words; the system offers a few readable candidates (name and duties) from the aliases in a controlled vocabulary, and you confirm one. Classification codes are kept internally only: you do not need to enter them and will not be asked to. If nothing matches, the system says why and does not turn it into “ordinary office worker”
input.capabilities.occupation_note.zh: 用自然语言描述你的工作；系统按受控词表的别名给出少量可读候选（名称与职责），由你确认。分类代码只在内部保留，不需要、也不会请你填写；匹配不到时说明原因，不自动改成“普通白领”

input.capabilities.occupation_note.v2.en: The new flow lets you browse the occupation catalog by group or search it and pick one directly (see input_catalog; no text needed). Describing your work in words is kept only for compatibility: the system offers a few readable candidates (name and duties) from the aliases of a controlled vocabulary, and you confirm one. Classification codes stay internal; you never need to enter one. When nothing matches, the system says why and never turns you into a “generic office worker”
input.capabilities.occupation_note.v2.zh: 新流程从职业目录按分类浏览或搜索后直接选（见 input_catalog，不需要写文字）。文字描述只为兼容保留：系统按受控词表的别名给出少量可读候选（名称与职责），由你确认。分类代码只在内部保留，不需要、也不会请你填写；匹配不到时说明原因，不自动改成“普通白领”

input.capabilities.ratings.equal_weight.en: “Equal weight” means you actively set every item to 50 points (each of the six dimensions gets 50/3, each of the four material items gets 25)
input.capabilities.ratings.equal_weight.zh: “同等重视”是你主动把每一项都设为 50 分（六维各得 50/3、物质四项各得 25）

input.capabilities.ratings.material_zero.en: When material life gets 0 points, the four material items do not apply: the points you already gave stay in the draft but are not used this time; they come back as they were when material life is above 0 again
input.capabilities.ratings.material_zero.zh: 物质生活打 0 分时物质四项不适用：已经打的分留在草稿里，不参与这一次的换算；物质重新大于 0 时照原样恢复

input.capabilities.ratings.normalize.en: Once every item that needs an answer is rated and the total is above 0, E3 turns ratings into weights as “100 × this item's rating ÷ the sum of all ratings” (exact fractions, no extra factors); scaling all ratings by the same factor leaves the weights unchanged
input.capabilities.ratings.normalize.zh: 全部要回答的项都打了分、合计大于 0 之后，E3 按“100 × 这一项的评分 ÷ 全部评分之和”换成权重（精确分数，不加任何系数）；评分同比例放大或缩小，权重不变

input.capabilities.ratings.range.en: Rate each item separately from 0 to 100: the slider moves 1 point at a time, and you can also type up to two decimals; the ratings need not add up to 100
input.capabilities.ratings.range.zh: 每一项单独打 0–100 分：滑条一次 1 分，也可以输入最多两位小数；不必凑满 100

input.capabilities.ratings.states.en: Not answered is not 0; “no strong view” and “not sure yet” keep their own state and are not turned into numbers; if every rating is 0 you cannot confirm, and the system does not split the weight evenly for you
input.capabilities.ratings.states.zh: 未答不是 0；“无所谓”“暂不确定”保留原状态，不换成数值；全部是 0 时不能确认，系统也不会自动平均分配

input.cash_missing.impact.en: Starting cash is unknown, so the starting state cannot be generated
input.cash_missing.impact.zh: 开局现金未知，不能生成开局

input.cash_missing.message.en: The money you can use for living at the start is not filled in yet (leaving it empty is not 0)
input.cash_missing.message.zh: 还没有填写开始时可用于生活的钱（没填不是 0）

input.cash_missing.next.en: Enter the amount, its currency and the period the amount is in
input.cash_missing.next.zh: 填写金额、币种与金额时期

input.catalog.experience.prompt.en: The starting job for {occupation} requires related work experience: at least {years} years in {related}. Enter how many years you worked in each of these occupations; if none, answer “no related experience”
input.catalog.experience.prompt.zh: {occupation}的开局岗位要求相关工作经验：在{related}里至少做过 {years} 年。请填你在这些职业里各做过几年；没有就回答“没有相关经验”

input.catalog.leisure.note.en: Pick as many as you like, or skip (skipping means not answered); the categories you pick are used for the evaluation directly, no text needed. “No fixed hobby”, “whatever the city offers” (generic leisure evaluation) and “not sure yet” can be chosen on their own
input.catalog.leisure.note.zh: 可以多选，也可以跳过（跳过就是未答）；选中的类别直接用于评价，不需要写文字。没有固定爱好、随当地体验（通用休闲评价）和暂不确定可以单独选

input.catalog.note.free_text.en: You can still add notes; they are only for the clones' planning: they do not change points, cash, qualifications or interest categories, and they never become hard requirements
input.catalog.note.free_text.zh: 补充文字仍可以写，只供分身做计划参考：它不改变点数、现金、资格或兴趣类别，也不会变成硬要求

input.catalog.note.groups.en: Occupation groups are only for browsing and do not change what an occupation means; each occupation is in exactly one group
input.catalog.note.groups.zh: 职业分组只用于浏览，不改变职业的含义；每个职业只在一个分组里

input.catalog.note.no_grant.en: Choosing an occupation never grants education, certificates or experience; those come from your answers to the qualification questions (the rules are applied by E3)
input.catalog.note.no_grant.zh: 选职业不会授予学历、证书或经验；这些按你在资格题里的回答换算（规则由 E3 统一执行）

input.catalog.search.no_match.en: No occupation in the catalog matches. This version supports only the {count} occupations in the catalog (teachers, nurses, doctors and others are not yet included); browse by group, or try a more common name. The system will not switch you to a different occupation
input.catalog.search.no_match.zh: 目录里没有找到匹配的职业。本版只支持目录里的 {count} 种职业（教师、护士、医生等暂不在范围内）；请按分类浏览，或换一个常用叫法。系统不会替你换成别的职业

input.catalog.search.rule.all_terms.en: Several words separated by spaces must all match: a word matches when it appears in any of the entry's search terms
input.catalog.search.rule.all_terms.zh: 用空格分开的几个词要全部命中：每个词出现在这个条目的任意一个搜索词里就算命中

input.catalog.search.rule.empty.en: With an empty search, all entries of the current group are shown in a fixed order
input.catalog.search.rule.empty.zh: 搜索为空时显示当前分组的全部条目，顺序固定

input.catalog.search.rule.normalize.en: Full-width and half-width characters are treated alike, English is case-insensitive, and leading or trailing spaces are ignored
input.catalog.search.rule.normalize.zh: 全角与半角统一、英文不分大小写、首尾空白忽略

input.catalog.search.rule.scope.en: Only entries already published in the catalog are filtered; no new entries are created. What you type in the search box is not saved and never enters your profile
input.catalog.search.rule.scope.zh: 只在目录已经发布的条目里筛选，不生成新条目；搜索框里的字不保存，也不进入画像

input.catalog.search.rule.server.en: What is submitted is the ID of the selected entry; the server checks the ID and the catalog version, never the search words
input.catalog.search.rule.server.zh: 提交的是选中条目的编号；服务端核对编号与目录版本，不认搜索词

input.catalog.state.certificates.provide.en: Grants the certificates you selected; selecting none means you have none of these certificates
input.catalog.state.certificates.provide.zh: 授予选中的证书；一张都不选表示没有这些证书

input.catalog.state.education.provided.m.en: Grants this level and every education threshold below it; does not grant occupational certificates
input.catalog.state.education.provided.m.zh: 授予这一级和它以下各级的学历门槛；不授予职业证书

input.catalog.state.education.unsure.mea.en: Treated as no confirmed education: grants no education threshold
input.catalog.state.education.unsure.mea.zh: 按没有确认学历处理：不授予学历门槛

input.catalog.state.experience.provided..en: Whether a requirement is met is judged from the occupations and years you enter; entering no experience means you have no related experience
input.catalog.state.experience.provided..zh: 按填写的职业与年数判断是否满足；不填任何经历表示没有相关经验

input.catalog.taste.note.en: Pick as many as you like, or skip (skipping means not answered); the cuisines you pick are used for the food evaluation directly, no text needed. “No taste preference” and “not sure yet” can be chosen on their own
input.catalog.taste.note.zh: 可以多选，也可以跳过（跳过就是未答）；选中的菜系直接用于饮食评价，不需要写文字。没有口味偏好和暂不确定可以单独选

input.cities_missing.impact.en: Without cities, no clones can be set up
input.cities_missing.impact.zh: 没有城市就不能安排分身

input.cities_missing.message.en: No cities to compare have been chosen yet
input.cities_missing.message.zh: 还没有选择要比较的城市

input.cities_missing.next.en: Choose at least one city from the capability list
input.cities_missing.next.zh: 从能力清单列出的城市里至少选一座

input.city_duplicated.impact.en: The same city is not counted twice

input.city_not_supported.impact.en: There is no data for this city, so it cannot be run
input.city_not_supported.impact.zh: 这座城市没有资料，不能运行

input.city_not_supported.message.en: City {ref} is not in this version's capability list
input.city_not_supported.message.zh: 城市 {ref} 不在本版能力清单里

input.city_not_supported.next.en: Choose from the cities in the capability list
input.city_not_supported.next.zh: 从能力清单列出的城市里选择

input.confirmation_invalidated.impact.en: The changed answers are not confirmed yet, so nothing can be run
input.confirmation_invalidated.impact.zh: 改过的答案还没有确认，不能运行

input.confirmation_invalidated.message.en: The original answers were changed after confirmation: the old confirmation is no longer valid
input.confirmation_invalidated.message.zh: 原始答案在确认之后改过：旧确认已经失效

input.confirmation_invalidated.next.en: Review and confirm again based on the changed answers
input.confirmation_invalidated.next.zh: 按修改后的答案重新审阅并确认

input.confirmation_tampered.impact.en: This confirmation cannot be used for a run

input.confirmation_tampered.message.en: The confirmed profile's content does not match the identity it recorded (it may have been altered)
input.confirmation_tampered.message.zh: 确认画像的内容与它记下的身份不一致（可能被改写过）

input.confirmed.hard_requirement.label.en: {label} {value} {unit} (checked and reported separately; it does not block plans)
input.confirmed.hard_requirement.label.zh: {label} {value} {unit}（单独核验并报告，不拦截计划）

input.data_pack_changed.impact.en: Cities, vocabulary or data have changed, so the old interpretation may no longer hold
input.data_pack_changed.impact.zh: 城市、词表或资料变了，旧的解释不一定还成立

input.data_pack_changed.message.en: The data pack the {where} is based on differs in content from the current data pack
input.data_pack_changed.message.zh: {where} 所依据的资料包与现在的资料包内容不同

input.data_pack_changed.next.en: Review and confirm again with the current data pack
input.data_pack_changed.next.zh: 用当前资料包重新审阅并确认

input.exact.money_negative.en: The amount “{text}” is negative: money available at the start cannot be negative (debt is outside what this version supports)
input.exact.money_negative.zh: 金额“{text}”是负数：开始时可用的钱不能是负数（欠款不在本版支持范围）

input.exact.money_negative.next.en: Enter an amount of 0 or more
input.exact.money_negative.next.zh: 填写不小于 0 的金额

input.exact.money_not_a_number.en: The amount “{text}” is not a non-negative decimal number
input.exact.money_not_a_number.zh: 金额“{text}”不是非负十进制数

input.exact.money_separator_invalid.en: The commas in the amount “{text}” are not used correctly: thousands must be grouped in threes (for example 3,000.50), and the decimal point must be “.”. The system does not guess what you meant: deleting the comma from “3000,50” would turn it into 300,050
input.exact.money_separator_invalid.zh: 金额“{text}”的逗号用法不对：千分位必须每三位一组（例如 3,000.50），小数点只能用“.”。系统不猜你的意思——“3000,50”删掉逗号会变成 300,050

input.exact.money_separator_invalid.next.en: Enter it again in a form like “3000.50” or “3,000.50”

input.exact.money_too_many_decimals.en: The amount “{text}” is more precise than the smallest accounting unit ({digits} decimal places)
input.exact.money_too_many_decimals.zh: 金额“{text}”的精度细于最小记账单位（{digits} 位小数）

input.exact.money_too_many_decimals.next.en: Write at most {digits} decimal places; it is not rounded automatically
input.exact.money_too_many_decimals.next.zh: 最多写 {digits} 位小数，不自动四舍五入

input.exact.points_fraction_not_canonica.en: The fraction “{text}” is not in lowest terms; write “{canonical}”
input.exact.points_fraction_not_canonica.zh: 分数“{text}”不是规范写法，应写“{canonical}”

input.exact.points_not_a_number.en: “{text}” is not a decimal number or a fraction in lowest terms

input.exact.points_too_many_decimals.en: “{text}” has {decimals} decimal places; manual entry in this version allows at most {max_decimals} (the step is not a measurement precision)
input.exact.points_too_many_decimals.zh: “{text}”有 {decimals} 位小数，本版手工输入最多 {max_decimals} 位（步长不是测量精度）

input.exact.rating_not_decimal.en: “{text}” is not a decimal number: write ratings as numbers from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals
input.exact.rating_not_decimal.zh: “{text}”不是十进制数：评分写成 0 到 100 之间、最多两位小数的数

input.free_text_too_long.impact.en: The system will not cut it automatically; the extra part cannot be dropped silently
input.free_text_too_long.impact.zh: 系统不会自动截断，超出部分不能静默丢弃

input.free_text_too_long.message.en: The additional text has {n} characters, over the 2,000 limit
input.free_text_too_long.message.zh: 补充文字有 {n} 个字符，超过 2,000 的上限

input.free_text_too_long.next.en: Shorten it yourself to 2,000 characters or fewer
input.free_text_too_long.next.zh: 自己删减到 2,000 字符以内

input.hard_requirement_conflict.impact.en: This hard requirement cannot be used yet, and the profile cannot be confirmed
input.hard_requirement_conflict.impact.zh: 这项硬要求还不能使用，画像不能确认

input.hard_requirement_conflict.message.en: “{label}” was given {n} times ({values}): each requirement can have only one entry; the system does not take the stricter limit automatically, nor does it use the last one
input.hard_requirement_conflict.message.zh: “{label}”收到了 {n} 条（{values}）：同一项要求只能有一条，系统不自动取更严格的上限，也不按最后一条算

input.hard_requirement_conflict.next.en: Keep only one entry, with the number you really want
input.hard_requirement_conflict.next.zh: 只保留一条，写你真正要的那个数

input.hard_requirement_duplicated.impact.en: This hard requirement cannot be used yet, and the profile cannot be confirmed
input.hard_requirement_duplicated.impact.zh: 这条硬要求还不能使用，画像不能确认

input.hard_requirement_duplicated.messag.en: Hard requirement ID {rid} appears {n} times: the system will not decide for you which one to keep
input.hard_requirement_duplicated.messag.zh: 硬要求编号 {rid} 出现了 {n} 次：系统不替你决定保留哪一条

input.hard_requirement_not_enforceable.i.en: The clones may still choose options that conflict with it (for example in-home services); this requirement is only kept, with no guarantee that it is followed
input.hard_requirement_not_enforceable.i.zh: 分身仍可能选择与它冲突的方案（例如上门服务）；这条要求只留存，不保证执行

input.hard_requirement_not_enforceable.m.en: “{text}” is marked non-negotiable, but this version has no way to check or enforce it
input.hard_requirement_not_enforceable.m.zh: “{text}”被标成不可妥协，但本版没有能核验或拦截它的机制

input.hard_requirement_not_enforceable.n.en: Acknowledge this and confirm, or change it to an ordinary preference
input.hard_requirement_not_enforceable.n.zh: 知悉后确认，或改成普通偏好

input.hard_requirement_parameter_invalid.en: This hard requirement cannot be used yet
input.hard_requirement_parameter_invalid.zh: 这条硬要求还不能使用

input.hard_requirement_parameter_invalid.en: “{label}” needs a whole number from {low} to {high} {unit} in steps of {step}; got {got}
Enter a value within the range

input.hard_requirement_unsupported.impac.en: It is only kept as written; it will not block plans and will not be checked
input.hard_requirement_unsupported.impac.zh: 它只原样留存，不会拦截计划，也不会被核验

input.hard_requirement_unsupported.messa.en: “{text}” is not a hard-requirement option this version can check
input.hard_requirement_unsupported.messa.zh: “{text}”不是本版能核验的硬要求选项

input.hard_requirement_unsupported.next.en: Acknowledge this and confirm, or choose from the supported options
input.hard_requirement_unsupported.next.zh: 知悉后确认，或从受支持的选项里选择

input.health.meaning.duplicated.en: This question received more than one answer: keep only one before confirming (the system will not choose for you)
input.health.meaning.duplicated.zh: 这一题收到了多个答案：确认前请只保留一个（系统不替你选）

input.health.meaning.no_clear_tendency.en: The user has no clear tendency on this question
input.health.meaning.no_clear_tendency.zh: 用户在这一题上没有明显倾向

input.health.meaning.unanswered.en: The user did not answer this question

input.health.meaning.unsure.en: The user is not sure yet

input.health_answer_duplicated.impact.en: The tendency on this question cannot be determined, so the profile cannot be confirmed
input.health_answer_duplicated.impact.zh: 这一题的倾向不能确定，画像不能确认

input.health_answer_duplicated.message.en: Health question {qid} received {n} answers ({choices}): each question can have only one answer; the system will not choose for you, nor use the last one
input.health_answer_duplicated.message.zh: 健康题 {qid} 收到了 {n} 个答案（{choices}）：同一题只能有一个答案，系统不替你选，也不按最后一个算

input.health_answer_duplicated.next.en: Keep only one answer (if you are unsure, you can choose “Not sure yet”)
input.health_answer_duplicated.next.zh: 只保留一个答案（拿不准可以选“暂不确定”）

input.health_question_unknown.impact.en: This question will not be used

input.health_question_unknown.next.en: Answer according to the current questionnaire

input.health_version_mismatch.impact.en: Answers to old questions cannot be reinterpreted as answers to new ones
input.health_version_mismatch.impact.zh: 旧题目的答案不能改读成新题目的答案

input.health_version_mismatch.message.en: The health answers were given under questionnaire {old}; the current questionnaire is {new}
input.health_version_mismatch.message.zh: 健康回答按问卷 {old} 填写，现在的问卷是 {new}

input.health_version_mismatch.next.en: Answer again under the current questionnaire

input.interests.adopted_with_unrecognize.en: {label}: adopting {names}; the unrecognized parts ({unrecognized}) are kept as written and not scored in this version
input.interests.adopted_with_unrecognize.zh: {label}：采用 {names}；没认出的片段（{unrecognized}）原样保留、本版不评分

input.interests.duplicate_selection.impa.en: A repeated category would make the confirmed profile fail when it is compiled; the system will not remove duplicates for you
input.interests.duplicate_selection.impa.zh: 重复的类别会让确认画像在编译时失败；系统不替你去重

input.interests.duplicate_selection.mess.en: In {label}, the same category was chosen more than once: {keys}

input.interests.duplicate_selection.revi.en: {label}: the same category was chosen more than once ({keys})

input.interests.scope.leisure.described.en: Leisure interests: personalized by the interests you confirmed ({names})
input.interests.scope.leisure.described.zh: 休闲兴趣：按你确认的兴趣（{names}）个性化

input.interests.scope.leisure.generic.en: Leisure interests: you chose the generic leisure evaluation (try whatever suitable the city offers); this time it is not personalized by specific interests
input.interests.scope.leisure.generic.zh: 休闲兴趣：你选择通用休闲评价（城市有什么合适的就体验什么），本次不按具体兴趣个性化

input.interests.scope.leisure.no_fixed_h.en: Leisure interests: you said you have no fixed hobby; this time it is not personalized by specific interests (evaluated with neutral rules)
input.interests.scope.leisure.no_fixed_h.zh: 休闲兴趣：你说明没有固定爱好，本次不按具体兴趣个性化（按中性规则评价）

input.interests.scope.leisure.unanswered.en: Leisure interests: you did not answer; this time it is not personalized by specific interests (evaluated with neutral rules)
input.interests.scope.leisure.unanswered.zh: 休闲兴趣：你没有回答，本次不按具体兴趣个性化（按中性规则评价）

input.qualification.section_not_offered..zh: 这个回答不会授予任何资格，画像不能确认

input.ratings.all_zero.impact.zh: 全部是 0 时没法换成权重；系统不会自动平均分配

input.ratings.all_zero.message.zh: {what}的评分全部是 0：至少有一项大于 0，或主动选择同等重视

input.ratings.all_zero.next.zh: 给你在意的项目打一个大于 0 的分，或选择同等重视（每项 50 分）

input.ratings.not_given.next.zh: 给它一个 0 到 100 的评分（可以是 0），或选择同等重视

input.statement.attribute_hard.message.zh: “{text}”：{note}。你把它标成了不可妥协的要求，但本版没有执行保障：它不会拦截任何计划，只原样留存

input.statement.attribute_unknown_kind.en: This version has no definition for this kind of preference: only the original text is kept
input.statement.attribute_unknown_kind.zh: 本版没有这类偏好的定义：只留存原文

input.summary.confirmable.en: The answers can be confirmed: please check the explanations below, and acknowledge the standard start and the statements that are only kept
input.summary.confirmable.zh: 答案可以确认：请核对下面的解释，并知悉标准开局与只留存的陈述

input.summary.equal_split_six.en: You chose an equal split for the six areas: 50/3 points each (shown as 16.7)
