input.summary.health_unclear.en: Health questions without a clear tendency (not answered or not sure yet): {n}. They are kept as they are, and the clones will be told there is no explicit instruction for them
input.summary.health_unclear.zh: 健康问卷有 {n} 题没有明确倾向（未答或暂不确定）：照实保留，分身会被告知没有这几项的明确指令

input.summary.single_city.en: Only one city is chosen: it can run, but there is no comparison between cities
input.summary.single_city.zh: 只选了一座城：可以运行，但没有城市之间的比较

input.version_changed.impact.en: Answers given under an old version of the questionnaire, vocabulary or conversion rules cannot be reused as they are
input.version_changed.impact.zh: 按旧版本问卷、词表或转换规则填写的答案不能直接沿用

input.version_changed.next.en: Fill in or confirm the related answers again under the current version
input.version_changed.next.zh: 按当前版本重新填写或重新确认相关答案

issue.e1_preflight_refused.impact.en: This comparison cannot start; the system will not drop cities or clones and then claim it ran the original comparison
issue.e1_preflight_refused.impact.zh: 这次比较不能启动；系统不会删掉城市或分身再声称执行了原比较

issue.e1_preflight_refused.message.en: The consistency check before the run did not pass: the compiled input, the data pack or the E1 configuration contradict each other (this is not a problem with your answers)
issue.e1_preflight_refused.message.zh: 运行前的一致性检查没有通过：编译出的输入、资料包或 E1 配置之间有矛盾（这不是你的答案的问题）

issue.e1_preflight_refused.next.en: Ask the maintainer to look at the internal diagnostics by the audit reference and fix the data or configuration, then run the pre-run check again
issue.e1_preflight_refused.next.zh: 请维护者按审计编号查看内部诊断并修复资料或配置，之后重新预检查

issue.idempotency_key_reused.message.en: This idempotency key was already used for another pre-run check: different runs cannot be submitted with the same key
issue.idempotency_key_reused.message.zh: 这个幂等键已经用于另一份预检查：不能用同一个键提交不同的运行

issue.idempotency_key_reused.next.en: Generate a new idempotency key for the new pre-run check
issue.idempotency_key_reused.next.zh: 为新的预检查生成新的幂等键

issue.profile_contract_rejected.impact.en: It cannot be compiled into E1 input, so this comparison cannot start
issue.profile_contract_rejected.impact.zh: 不能编译成 E1 输入，这次比较不能启动

issue.profile_contract_rejected.message.en: The confirmed profile did not pass the E1 profile contract check (for example, two hard requirements for the same need)
issue.profile_contract_rejected.message.zh: 确认画像没有通过 E1 画像契约的检查（例如同一项需求有两条硬要求）

issue.profile_contract_rejected.next.en: Go back to the review page, correct it and confirm again; if the review page shows no hint, ask the maintainer to investigate by the audit reference
issue.profile_contract_rejected.next.zh: 回到审阅页修正之后重新确认；如果审阅页没有提示，请维护者按审计编号排查

issue.review_stale.message.en: The review you referred to is not the review of the current draft version (the draft or the data pack changed after the review)
issue.review_stale.message.zh: 确认引用的审阅不是当前这一版草稿的审阅（草稿或资料包在审阅之后变了）

issue.review_stale.next.en: Review the current draft again, then confirm
issue.review_stale.next.zh: 重新审阅当前的草稿后再确认

preflight.no_component.next.zh: 知悉这一限制，或调整分配

preflight.planner.mock_free.en: Controlled, deterministic offline planner (mock): it only tests wiring, state passing and information isolation and does not represent the abilities of a real large language model; no network calls, cost 0

preflight.start_job_unmatched.message.zh: {city} 的目录里没有与“{occupation}”同一分类的岗位

preflight.start_job_unmatched.next.en: Choose a city that has a matching job, or check your occupation description
preflight.start_job_unmatched.next.zh: 换一座有对应岗位的城市，或核对职业描述

preflight.tampered.message.en: The pre-run check's content does not match its recorded identity
preflight.tampered.message.zh: 预检查的内容与它记下的身份不一致

preflight.treatment_unknown.impact.en: If a clone plans treatment and hits unknown data, that clone stops in that month and it is recorded as a data gap
preflight.treatment_unknown.impact.zh: 分身计划要治而遇到资料未知时，那个分身会停在那个月并记为资料缺口

preflight.treatment_unknown.message.en: {city}: data on {treatment} is unknown (not free, and not absent)
preflight.treatment_unknown.message.zh: {city} 的{treatment}资料未知（不是免费，也不是没有）

preflight.years_unsupported.message.en: These run settings are for {years} years, but the data pack is validated only for {supported} years
preflight.years_unsupported.message.zh: 这次运行设置是 {years} 年，资料包只配套验证了 {supported} 年

preflight.years_unsupported.next.en: Choose a number of years the data pack supports, then prepare again
preflight.years_unsupported.next.zh: 选择资料包支持的年数后重新准备

progress.clone_status.completed.zh: 正常生活完 N 年

progress.clone_status.feedback_blocked.en: Energy feedback blocked (the next year's allowance could not be determined)
progress.clone_status.feedback_blocked.zh: 精力反馈受阻（下一年额度无法确定）

progress.clone_status.life_exit.en: Confirmed life exit (could not pay for the minimum housing and food)
progress.clone_status.life_exit.zh: 确认的生活出局（付不起最低住房与食品）

progress.clone_status.not_run.en: Not run (the global budget ran out, or the batch paused before reaching it)
progress.clone_status.not_run.zh: 没有运行（全局预算用尽或批次暂停之前没有轮到）

progress.clone_status.planning_stopped.en: Planning not completed (revisions used up, a city data problem, or the global call limit used up)
progress.clone_status.planning_stopped.zh: 规划没有完成（修订耗尽、城市资料问题或全局调用上限用尽）

progress.clone_status.program_error.en: Program or configuration error (not assumed to affect only this clone)
progress.clone_status.program_error.zh: 程序或配置错误（不假定只影响这个分身）

progress.clone_status.stopped.en: E1-5C stop (not enough contingency arrangements after an illness, or a data gap)
progress.clone_status.stopped.zh: E1-5C 停止（疾病之后应急安排不足或资料缺口）

progress.cost.estimated.en: Estimated on the application side from quote {price_version}, not the provider's bill (the bill prevails): settled + uncertain usage (reservation kept, not counted as 0) + reservations in flight; cap for this run {max_cost} {currency}
progress.cost.estimated.zh: 应用侧按报价 {price_version} 估算，不是供应商账单（以账单为准）：已核算 + 用量不确定（保留预留，不记 0） + 在途预留；本次运行上限 {max_cost} {currency}

progress.cost.offline_mock.en: Offline mock: no network calls, cost 0 (a real-model run says “estimated from the quote”, and the provider's bill prevails)
progress.cost.offline_mock.zh: 离线 mock：没有网络调用，费用为 0（真实模型运行会写“按报价估算”，以供应商账单为准）

progress.halt.account.en: The model service account's status does not allow calls; the batch stopped
progress.halt.account.zh: 模型服务账户的状态不允许调用，批次停下

progress.halt.bad_request.en: The model service does not support this request's configuration; the batch stopped
progress.halt.bad_request.zh: 模型服务不支持这次请求的配置，批次停下

progress.halt.budget.en: The paid budget is not enough to send the next request; the batch stopped
progress.halt.budget.zh: 付费预算不足以发出下一次请求，批次停下

progress.halt.credentials.en: The model service credentials are unavailable; the batch stopped
progress.halt.credentials.zh: 模型服务的凭证不可用，批次停下

progress.halt.impact.en: This is not a life result

progress.halt.input_limit.en: The next request is over the input length limit; the batch stopped (no facts are cut)
progress.halt.input_limit.zh: 下一份请求超过了输入长度上限，批次停下（不删减事实）

progress.halt.model_mismatch.en: The service returned a different model from the configured one, so the reply cannot be used for planning; the batch stopped
progress.halt.model_mismatch.zh: 服务返回的模型与设定不同，回复不能用于规划，批次停下

progress.halt.next.en: The maintainer deals with the service, credential, budget or request problem
progress.halt.next.zh: 维护者处理服务、凭证、预算或请求的问题

progress.halt.request_check.en: The final request did not pass the information-isolation check; the batch stopped
progress.halt.request_check.zh: 最终请求没有通过信息隔离检查，批次停下

progress.halt.service_unavailable.en: The model service is temporarily unavailable (timeout, disconnection, rate limit or server error); the batch stopped
progress.halt.service_unavailable.zh: 模型服务暂时不可用（超时、断连、限流或服务端错误），批次停下

progress.halt.uncertain_send.en: The previous request may have been sent but its result was not reliably saved; to avoid paying twice, the batch stopped
progress.halt.uncertain_send.zh: 上一次请求可能已经发出但结果没有可靠落盘，为免重复付费，批次停下

progress.halt.user_deletion.en: You deleted this run; the system sends no new model requests, and the batch stopped
progress.halt.user_deletion.zh: 你删除了这次运行，系统不再发出新的模型请求，批次停下

progress.pause.batch_paused_program_erro.en: Both kinds of clones are simulation gaps (not life exits) and are not in the average of complete clones
progress.pause.batch_paused_program_erro.zh: 这两类分身都是模拟缺失（不是生活出局），不进完成者平均

progress.pause.batch_paused_program_erro.en: The maintainer looks at the internal records by the audit reference and fixes the problem
progress.pause.batch_paused_program_erro.zh: 维护者按审计编号查看内部记录并修复

progress.pause.batch_paused_program_erro.en: The batch paused because of a program or configuration problem: the clone with the error is recorded as a program error, and clones not yet reached are kept as not run
progress.pause.batch_paused_program_erro.zh: 批次因程序或配置问题暂停：出错的分身记为程序错误，还没轮到的分身保留为未运行

progress.pause.call_limit_reached.impact.en: Clones that did not run are recorded as not run (simulation gaps), not as life exits
progress.pause.call_limit_reached.impact.zh: 没有运行的分身记为未运行（模拟缺失），不写成生活出局

progress.pause.call_limit_reached.next.en: The owner decides whether to raise the limit
progress.pause.call_limit_reached.next.zh: 由所有者决定是否提高上限

progress.pause.call_limit_reached.reason.en: The global call limit ran out, so the remaining clones did not run
progress.pause.call_limit_reached.reason.zh: 全局调用上限用尽，后面的分身没有运行

progress.pause.interrupted.impact.en: Years already committed are kept in the archive
progress.pause.interrupted.impact.zh: 已经提交的年份保留在归档里

progress.pause.interrupted.reason.en: The run was interrupted between two planning calls
progress.pause.interrupted.reason.zh: 运行在两次规划调用之间中断

progress.pause.not_resumable.en: This run cannot be resumed; after the problem is dealt with, rerun as a new run
progress.pause.not_resumable.zh: 这次运行不能恢复，处理之后用新的运行重跑

progress.pause.report_missing.en: The evaluation and summary have not been generated yet; no categories or scores are made up
progress.pause.report_missing.zh: 还没有生成评价与汇总，不擅自给出分类或分数

progress.pause.report_ready.en: The evaluation and summary have been generated and the results can be viewed (C / E / M as categorised above)
progress.pause.report_ready.zh: 评价与汇总已经生成，可以查看结果（C / E / M 按上面的分类）

progress.pause.resumable.en: The same run can be resumed (the archive is checked item by item before resuming, and the calls and budget already used are not reset); the system does not make plans for clones
progress.pause.resumable.zh: 可以恢复同一次运行（恢复前逐条核对归档，已用的调用次数与预算不清零）；系统不会替分身生成计划

progress.placeholder.cost_queued.en: Not started yet: no model request has been sent
progress.placeholder.cost_queued.zh: 还没有开始：没有发出任何模型请求

progress.placeholder.cost_started.en: Just started: the cost follows the next progress snapshot
progress.placeholder.cost_started.zh: 刚开始：费用以下一份进度快照为准

progress.placeholder.resume_queued.en: Not started yet, so there is nothing to resume
progress.placeholder.resume_queued.zh: 还没有开始，没有可以恢复的部分

progress.placeholder.started.en: The simulation has just started; the first progress snapshot has not been written yet
progress.placeholder.started.zh: 模拟刚开始，第一份进度还没有写下

progress.resume.finished.en: This run has finished; there is nothing to resume
progress.resume.finished.zh: 这次运行已经结束，没有可以恢复的部分

progress.resume.maintainer.en: This run stopped at a point you cannot resume from: wait for the maintainer (attempts and budget are not reset to get around it)
progress.resume.maintainer.zh: 这次运行停在不能由你恢复的位置：等维护者处理（尝试次数与预算不会被清零来绕过）

progress.resume.resumable.en: It can resume from a year boundary or between two candidates (E1's resume entry checks the archive item by item; attempts and calls are not reset)
progress.resume.resumable.zh: 可以从年度边界或两份候选之间恢复（E1 的恢复入口逐条核对归档，尝试次数与调用次数不清零）

progress.resume.running.en: This run is in progress and needs no resuming; this will update after it finishes or pauses
progress.resume.running.zh: 这次运行正在进行，不需要恢复；结束或暂停之后这里会更新

progress.stage.halted.en: Batch stopped (service, budget or request check)
progress.stage.halted.zh: 批次停下（服务、预算或请求检查）

progress.stage.interrupted.zh: 在两次规划调用之间中断

progress.stage.paused.zh: 批次暂停（程序或配置问题）

progress_summary.assembling.en: The simulation has ended; assembling the results
progress_summary.assembling.zh: 模拟已经结束，正在整理结果

progress_summary.awaiting_confirmation.en: The check passed; waiting for you to confirm the start
progress_summary.awaiting_confirmation.zh: 检查通过，等你确认开始

progress_summary.blocked.en: Stopped before starting: see the explanation for the reason and what to do next
progress_summary.blocked.zh: 开始之前停下了：原因与下一步见说明

progress_summary.checking.en: Checking in the background whether this simulation can start (this does not use a run)
progress_summary.checking.zh: 正在后台检查这次模拟能不能开始（不使用次数）

progress_summary.checking_authorized.en: Checking in the background; once it passes, it starts automatically as you confirmed
progress_summary.checking_authorized.zh: 正在后台检查；通过后按你的确认自动开始

progress_summary.finished.en: Results are ready (completions, exits and simulation gaps are in the results)
progress_summary.finished.zh: 结果可以查看（完成、出局与模拟缺失见结果）

progress_summary.finished_counted.en: Results are ready: {settled}/{planned} clone-years settled (completions, exits and simulation gaps are in the results)
progress_summary.finished_counted.zh: 结果可以查看：已结算 {settled}/{planned} 个分身年度（完成、出局与模拟缺失见结果）

progress_summary.paid_off.en: The check passed; waiting for the maintainer to enable paid model calls
progress_summary.paid_off.zh: 检查通过，等维护者开启付费模型调用

progress_summary.queued.zh: 已确认开始，排队等待启动

progress_summary.queued_resume.en: Already started before; queued to resume
progress_summary.queued_resume.zh: 已经开始过，排队等待恢复

progress_summary.result_unreadable.en: The simulation has ended, but the results cannot be read right now
progress_summary.result_unreadable.zh: 模拟结束了，但结果暂时读不到

progress_summary.simulating.zh: 已结算 {settled}/{planned} 个分身年度

progress_summary.simulating_uncounted.en: The simulation is running (this progress record does not include the number of settled clone-years)
progress_summary.simulating_uncounted.zh: 模拟进行中（这份进度快照没有记下已结算的分身年度数）

progress_summary.start_void.en: The start authorization is no longer valid: read the explanation and confirm again
progress_summary.start_void.zh: 开始授权已经作废：需要你看过说明后重新确认

progress_summary.started.en: The simulation has just started; the first progress record has not been written yet
progress_summary.started.zh: 模拟刚开始，第一份进度还没有写下

progress_summary.starting.en: The check passed; starting as you confirmed
progress_summary.starting.zh: 检查通过，正在按你的确认开始

progress_summary.stopped_maintainer.en: Stopped: {settled}/{planned} clone-years settled; waiting for the maintainer
progress_summary.stopped_maintainer.zh: 停下了：已结算 {settled}/{planned} 个分身年度，等维护者处理

progress_summary.stopped_resumable.en: Stopped: {settled}/{planned} clone-years settled; you can resume
progress_summary.stopped_resumable.zh: 停下了：已结算 {settled}/{planned} 个分身年度，可以恢复

result.category.M.en: Simulation problem, cannot be fully evaluated
result.category.M.zh: 模拟问题，无法完整评价

result.city.counts.en: {city}: clones planned {planned} — completed and evaluable {complete}, life exits {exits}, simulation problems {missing}
result.city.counts.zh: {city}：原计划 {planned} 个分身——{complete} 个完成且可评价、{exits} 个生活出局、{missing} 个模拟问题

result.city.headline_mean.en: {counts}; the average J of the completed and evaluable clones ({complete}) is {mean_j} (the denominator counts only completed and evaluable clones, not all planned clones)
result.city.headline_mean.zh: {counts}；{complete} 个完成且可评价分身的平均 J 为 {mean_j}（分母只数完成且可评价的分身，不是原计划的全部分身）

result.city.headline_no_mean.zh: {counts}；没有可用于平均的完整结果

result.city.note.all_exit.en: All confirmed exits: the average and the missing range are both empty; exit share 100%
result.city.note.all_exit.zh: 全部确认出局：均值与缺失范围都为空；出局比例 100%

result.city.note.hard_requirements.en: Some clones did not meet, could not be judged against, or have not yet been checked against the user's hard requirements (not checked = no trusted record, not checked and fine): see the hard requirements section; a high average does not mean the user's requirements were fully met
result.city.note.hard_requirements.zh: 有分身没有满足、无法判断或尚未核验用户的硬要求（未核验 = 没有可信记录，不是核验过、没问题）：见硬要求一节；均值高不代表完全符合用户要求

result.city.note.no_complete.en: No fully evaluated clones: the average of complete clones is empty (not filled with 0, and L is not used in place of J); only the missing range is given
result.city.note.no_complete.zh: 没有完整评价的分身：完整者均值为空（不填 0，不用 L 代替 J），只给缺失范围

result.city.note.no_range.en: No clones that are complete or have a computable range (for example, all life exits): the simulation missing range is empty
result.city.note.no_range.zh: 没有完整或可算范围的分身（例如全部生活出局）：模拟缺失范围为空

result.city.note.single_complete.en: Only 1 fully evaluated clone: the average is just its J, not stable sampling evidence
result.city.note.single_complete.zh: 只有 1 个完整评价分身：均值就是它的 J，不是稳定的抽样证据

result.city.note.unexpected_error.en: There was an unexpected program error: do not assume it affected only this clone; find the cause before reading this report
result.city.note.unexpected_error.zh: 有意外程序错误：不能假定它只影响这一个分身，先查原因再解读这份报告

result.clone.complete.impact.en: Counted in this city's average of completed and evaluable clones
result.clone.complete.impact.zh: 计入这座城完成且可评价分身的平均

result.clone.complete.next.en: See the year-by-year life facts; this is a result under the synthetic model, not a real-world prediction
result.clone.complete.next.zh: 看逐年生活事实；这是合成模型下的结果，不是现实预测

result.clone.complete.reason.en: Three years of life completed normally; the actual scores and the end-of-period valuation are both complete
result.clone.complete.reason.zh: 三年生活正常完成，实际评分与期末估值都完整

result.clone.data_missing.next.en: Rerun after the data is completed

result.clone.data_missing.reason.en: City data needed for settlement is missing or incomplete
result.clone.data_missing.reason.zh: 结算要用的城市资料缺失或不完整

result.clone.feedback_blocked.next.en: Rerun after the scoring data is completed
result.clone.feedback_blocked.next.zh: 补齐评分资料之后重跑

result.clone.feedback_blocked.reason.en: The previous year's score was incomplete, so the next year's energy allowance could not be determined and life did not continue
result.clone.feedback_blocked.reason.zh: 上一年评分不完整，下一年的精力额度无法确定，生活没有继续

result.clone.life_exit.impact.en: Not in the average of complete clones, and not in the simulation missing range; the exit share uses the planned number of clones as its denominator
result.clone.life_exit.impact.zh: 不进完成者平均，也不进模拟缺失范围；出局比例以原计划人数为分母

result.clone.life_exit.next.en: See the event chain for what happened (environment records, not proof of cause)
result.clone.life_exit.next.zh: 看事件链了解经过（环境记录，不是因果证明）

result.clone.life_exit.reason.en: Confirmed life exit: could not pay for the minimum housing and food
result.clone.life_exit.reason.zh: 确认的生活出局：付不起最低住房与食品

result.clone.not_in_mean.en: Not in the average of complete clones; the city's simulation missing range treats it as unknown (anything from 0 to 1 is kept), and it is not written up as a life exit
result.clone.not_in_mean.zh: 不进完成者平均；城市的模拟缺失范围把它当作未知（0 到 1 之间都保留），不写成生活出局

result.clone.not_run.next.en: After the batch problem is dealt with, rerun as a new run
result.clone.not_run.next.zh: 批次的问题处理之后，用新的运行重跑

result.clone.not_run.reason.en: This clone did not run or returned no result (for example, the batch paused before reaching it, or the global call limit ran out)
result.clone.not_run.reason.zh: 这个分身没有运行或没有返回结果（例如批次在轮到它之前暂停，或全局调用上限用尽）

result.clone.plan_or_execution_incomplet.en: This is a planning or simulation problem, not a life exit; rerun after improving the planner or the instructions
result.clone.plan_or_execution_incomplet.zh: 这是规划或模拟的问题，不是生活出局；改进规划器或说明之后重跑

result.clone.plan_or_execution_incomplet.en: The annual plan was not completed (for example, planning revisions ran out, or the plan was never valid)
result.clone.plan_or_execution_incomplet.zh: 年度计划没有完成（例如规划修订次数用完、计划始终不合法）

result.clone.program_error.next.en: The maintainer looks at the internal records by the audit reference, fixes the problem and reruns as a new run; internal error content is not shown here
result.clone.program_error.next.zh: 维护者按审计编号查看内部记录、修复之后用新的运行重跑；这里不显示内部错误内容

result.clone.program_error.reason.en: The simulation program or configuration failed, and this clone did not complete (not a life exit)
result.clone.program_error.reason.zh: 模拟程序或配置出错，这个分身没有完成（不是生活出局）

result.clone.score_incomplete.next.en: Recompute after the scoring data is completed
result.clone.score_incomplete.next.zh: 补齐评分资料之后重算

result.clone.score_incomplete.reason.en: Life ended normally, but some months' scoring data is unknown (data for an item with positive weight is missing)
result.clone.score_incomplete.reason.zh: 生活正常结束，但有月份的评分资料未知（有正权重的项目资料缺失）

result.clone.stopped.next.en: See the event records; rerun after improving the contingency arrangements or completing the treatment data
result.clone.stopped.next.zh: 看事件记录；改进应急安排或补齐治疗资料之后重跑

result.clone.stopped.reason.en: Not enough contingency arrangements after an illness, or a gap in the treatment data, so the simulation stopped in that month (a support limit of the simulation, not a life exit)
result.clone.stopped.reason.zh: 疾病之后应急安排不足或治疗资料缺口，模拟在那个月停止（模拟的支持边界，不是生活出局）

result.clone.valuation_incomplete.next.en: This is a problem in the evaluation step; recompute after completing the data or the reference templates
result.clone.valuation_incomplete.next.zh: 这是评价环节的问题；补齐资料或参考模板之后重算

result.clone.valuation_incomplete.reason.en: The actual life is complete, but the end-of-period valuation is incomplete or there is no usable reference branch
result.clone.valuation_incomplete.reason.zh: 实际生活完整，但期末估值不完整或没有可用的参考分支

result.comparison.a_higher.en: Under these missing ranges city A is always higher: the direction is consistent; this is not a significance test, nor a causal conclusion about the population
result.comparison.a_higher.zh: 在这些缺失范围下 A 城始终更高：方向一致；不是显著性检验，也不是总体因果结论

result.comparison.b_higher.en: Under these missing ranges city B is always higher: the direction is consistent; this is not a significance test, nor a causal conclusion about the population
result.comparison.b_higher.zh: 在这些缺失范围下 B 城始终更高：方向一致；不是显著性检验，也不是总体因果结论

result.comparison.not_available.en: One city had only confirmed exits, so there are no ranges to compare; look at the exit shares
result.comparison.not_available.zh: 有一座城全部确认出局，没有范围可比；看出局比例

result.comparison.note.en: {direction}. Exit share A {exit_a}, B {exit_b}; effective clones A {complete_a}/{planned_a}, B {complete_b}/{planned_b}
result.comparison.note.zh: {direction}。出局比例 A {exit_a}、B {exit_b}，有效分身数 A {complete_a}/{planned_a}、B {complete_b}/{planned_b}

result.comparison.undetermined.en: The range difference includes 0: the direction cannot be determined under these missing ranges
result.comparison.undetermined.zh: 范围差含 0：在这些缺失范围下不能确定方向

result.limit.not_fed_back.en: Results are shown only to the user and are not fed back to clones still living
result.limit.not_fed_back.zh: 结果只给用户看，不回灌给仍在生活中的分身

result.limit.option_coverage.en: Option catalog coverage only says whether the candidates surveyed within the declared scope have complete data; it does not guarantee that the whole city market was covered
result.limit.option_coverage.zh: 选项目录覆盖只说明声明范围内调查过的候选资料齐不齐，不保证穷尽整个城市市场

result.missing_reason.input_config_progr.zh: 输入 / 配置 / 程序错误

result.missing_reason.stopped.en: E1-5C stop (not enough contingency arrangements, or a data gap)
result.missing_reason.stopped.zh: E1-5C 停止（应急安排不足或资料缺口）

result.missing_reason.valuation_incomple.en: End-of-period valuation incomplete, or no usable reference branch
result.missing_reason.valuation_incomple.zh: 期末估值不完整或没有可用参考分支

result.not_generated.en: The run status is “{stage}”; the evaluation and summary have not been generated yet, and no categories or scores are made up
result.not_generated.zh: 运行状态是“{stage}”，还没有生成评价与汇总；不擅自生成分类或分数

result.option_coverage.note.en: Option catalog coverage: whether the data on the convenience devices and services surveyed within the declared scope is complete; this is separate from whether this city's trajectories can be scored
result.option_coverage.note.zh: 选项目录覆盖：声明范围内调查过的便利设备与服务资料齐不齐；与这座城的轨迹能否评分是两件事

result.reading.chores.en: Reducing daily chores itself counts as convenience satisfaction; unscheduled free time earns no extra points
result.reading.chores.zh: 减少日常杂务本身对应便利满足感；没有安排的空闲时间不额外加分

result.reading.event_chain.en: The event chain is written from checked environment records; it is not the model's reasoning, nor proof of cause; hard requirements are reported separately, without deducting points or removing anyone
result.reading.event_chain.zh: 事件链按核对过的环境记录写成，不是模型的理由，也不是因果证明；硬要求单独报告，不扣分、不删人

result.reading.exits.en: Confirmed life exits (E) are not in the average, nor in the simulation missing range; the exit and missing shares use the planned number of clones as their denominator
result.reading.exits.zh: 确认的生活出局（E）不进均值，也不进模拟缺失范围；出局与缺失的比例以原计划人数为分母

result.reading.l_v_j.en: L is the average monthly satisfaction over the actual years; V is the valuation from the end state within reference life templates and treatment branches frozen in advance — not a prediction of the future, nor a global optimum; J combines the two by month weights
result.reading.l_v_j.zh: L 是实际几年逐月满足感的平均；V 是从终态出发、在预先冻结的参考生活模板与治疗分支里的估值，不是对未来的预测，也不是全局最优；J 按月份权重合成两者

result.reading.mean_denominator.en: The denominator of the average J of complete clones is C (completed and fully evaluated clones), not the planned number; when C = 0 there is no average, and it is not shown as 0
result.reading.mean_denominator.zh: 完整者平均 J 的分母是 C（完成且评价完整的分身），不是原计划人数；C = 0 时没有平均值，不显示为 0

result.reading.missing_range.en: The denominator of the simulation missing range is C + M: known months are counted as they are, and the unknown part keeps everything from 0 to 1. It is not a confidence interval, nor a probability of real-world happiness
result.reading.missing_range.zh: 模拟缺失范围的分母是 C + M：已知的月份照算，未知部分在 0 到 1 之间都保留。它不是置信区间，也不是现实幸福的概率

result.reading.precision.en: Scores are computed under the current synthetic model from the stated preferences you confirmed; differences in the last decimal places do not make a reliable ranking
result.reading.precision.zh: 分数是当前合成模型下、按你确认的陈述偏好计算的结果；小数末位的差异不构成可靠的排序

result.reading.simulation_problems.en: Missing data, unfinished planning, stops and program problems are simulation problems (M), not written up as “could not make a living in this city”
result.reading.simulation_problems.zh: 资料缺失、规划没有完成、停止与程序问题是模拟问题（M），不写成“在这座城活不下去”

result.source.area_facts.en: Areas, commuting, car access, device failures and tax: the single monthly commute record in E1's monthly resource ledger and the settlement records (not including the failure draws)
result.source.area_facts.zh: 片区、通勤、用车权、设备故障与税：E1 月度资源账里每月唯一的通勤记录与结算记录（不含故障抽签）

result.source.evaluation.en: Evaluation: E1-6A per-clone intertemporal evaluation (L / V / J); summary: E1-6B city report (C / E / M, averages, simulation missing ranges, event chains, hard requirements)
result.source.evaluation.zh: 评价：E1-6A 单分身跨期评价（L / V / J）；汇总：E1-6B 城市报告（C / E / M、均值、模拟缺失范围、事件链、硬要求）

result.source.life_facts.en: Life facts: E1 settlement records (money, jobs, housing, food, service months) and the monthly resource ledger (own household hours)
result.source.life_facts.zh: 生活事实：E1 结算记录（钱、岗位、住房、食品、服务月份）与月度资源账（本人家务小时）

result.source.pack_real.en: Data: frozen real data pack {pack_id} ({fingerprint}…): city data comes from public sources and registered model settings (the source nature of each city is in data_nature); life rules, scoring and evaluation parameters are synthetic exploratory settings
result.source.pack_real.zh: 资料：冻结的真实资料包 {pack_id}（{fingerprint}…）：城市资料来自公开来源与登记的模型设定（逐城的来源性质见 data_nature）；生活规则、评分与评价参数是合成探索设定

result.source.pack_synthetic.en: Data: synthetic data pack {pack_id} ({fingerprint}…) and the product protocol's base samples; everything is a synthetic setting
result.source.pack_synthetic.zh: 资料：合成资料包 {pack_id}（{fingerprint}…）与产品协议的基础样例；全部是合成设定

result.valuation.use_not_in_templates.en: The “{item}” held at the end has {months} more month(s) of use: the reference templates do not consider its use ({capabilities}), so the end-of-period valuation does not count this use — this is a scope limit of the reference templates, not a statement that the equipment has no value
result.valuation.use_not_in_templates.zh: 期末持有的「{item}」还能用 {months} 个月：参考模板没有考虑它的用途（{capabilities}），期末估值没有计入这项用途——这是参考模板的范围限制，不是说这件装备没有价值

result.valuation.use_valued.en: The “{item}” held at the end has {months} more month(s) of use: the end-of-period reference life keeps arranging the matching activities by its capabilities ({capabilities}), using it for its remaining life without buying it again
result.valuation.use_valued.zh: 期末持有的「{item}」还能用 {months} 个月：期末参考生活按它的能力（{capabilities}）继续安排相应活动，剩余寿命内照用、不重复购买

rules.cost_cap.en: By default each run's cost cap is {cost} {currency} (reserved by the app from the price quote; it is not a supplier billing limit), and the budget is not topped up automatically
rules.cost_cap.zh: 默认每次运行的费用上限是 {cost} {currency}（应用侧按报价预留，不是供应商账单上限），不自动加预算

rules.default_scale.en: By default: {cities} metro area(s), {clones} clone(s) per city, {years} year(s) for each clone
rules.default_scale.zh: 默认比较 {cities} 个都会区、每城 {clones} 个分身、每个分身 {years} 年

rules.mock.en: This service instance uses the offline planner (mock): no network calls, cost 0, and it does not represent a real model's ability
rules.mock.zh: 这个服务实例使用离线规划器（mock）：没有网络调用、费用为 0，不代表真实模型的能力

rules.options.cities.en: Cities come from your confirmed profile: you can compare just some of them, but all must be among the allowed cities; none are removed or added for you
rules.options.cities.zh: 城市来自你确认的画像：可以只比较其中几座，但都要在允许的城市里，不会替你删城或补城

rules.options.clones.en: {low}–{high} clones per city ({default} if you do not choose); more clones show more of the role of luck within one city, but planning requests and cost grow in proportion
rules.options.clones.zh: 每城分身 {low}–{high} 个（不选就是 {default} 个）；分身越多，同一座城的结果越能看出运气的影响，但规划请求与费用也按比例增加

rules.options.cost.en: Cost cap {low}–{high} yuan ({default} yuan if you do not choose): shared by all cities, all clones and all service attempts in this run; a larger scale does not add budget automatically, and the run stops when the cost is not enough for the next request
rules.options.cost.zh: 费用上限 {low}–{high} 元（不选就是 {default} 元）：这次运行的全部城市、全部分身、全部服务尝试共用；扩大规模不会自动加预算，费用不够发下一次请求时就停下

rules.options.years.en: Only {years} years are offered, the length the data pack has been validated for
rules.options.years.zh: 年数只开放资料包配套验证过的 {years} 年

rules.paid_off.en: Paid model calls are not turned on right now: you can fill in and check, but cannot start a simulation
rules.paid_off.zh: 付费模型调用现在没有开启：可以填写与检查，但不能开始模拟

rules.profile_retention.en: A confirmed profile can be used to prepare new simulations for {days} days from its first confirmation
rules.profile_retention.zh: 确认画像从首次确认起 {days} 天内可以用来准备新的模拟

rules.result_retention.en: Results are kept for {days} days from the run's first finish; viewing does not extend this, and you can delete them at any time
rules.result_retention.zh: 结果从运行首次结束起保存 {days} 天，查看不续期；可以随时删除

rules.runs_total.en: Each personal space has {runs} simulation run(s) in total, and they do not reset; whatever scale you choose, actually starting once uses one run, and not every clone is guaranteed to complete each time
rules.runs_total.zh: 每个专属空间一共 {runs} 次启动模拟的机会，不自动重置；无论选多大的规模，真正开始一次就用掉一次机会，不保证每次所有分身都完整

stage.awaiting_confirmation.en: Waiting for you to confirm the start

stage.awaiting_confirmation_authorized.en: The check passed; starting as you confirmed
stage.awaiting_confirmation_authorized.zh: 检查通过，正在按你的确认开始

stage.awaiting_confirmation_void.en: The start authorization is no longer valid; waiting for you to confirm again
stage.awaiting_confirmation_void.zh: 开始授权已经作废，等你重新确认

stage.blocked.en: The pre-run check did not pass

stage.checking.en: Queued for checking: the service runs pre-run checks in order, and no run is used
stage.checking.zh: 排队检查中：运行前检查由服务按顺序执行，不使用次数

stage.checking_authorized.en: Queued for checking: once the check passes, it starts automatically as you confirmed (checking does not use a run)
stage.checking_authorized.zh: 排队检查中：检查通过后按你的确认自动开始（检查不使用次数）

stage.finished.en: This service flow has ended (the results state, city by city, how many completed, exited or are simulation gaps)
stage.finished.zh: 本次服务流程结束（结果里逐城写明完成、出局与模拟缺失）

stage.queued.en: Confirmed; waiting in the queue for the first start
stage.queued.zh: 已确认，排队等待首次启动

stage.queued_resume.en: Already started; waiting in the queue to resume (no extra run is used)
stage.queued_resume.zh: 已经开始过，排队等待恢复（不另扣次数）

start.ack.auto_start.en: Once the check passes, the simulation starts with these settings without asking again; if the check does not pass or the conditions change, it stops and explains why
start.ack.auto_start.zh: 检查通过就按这些设置自动开始，不再询问；检查没有通过或条件变了就停下说明

start.ack.cost_cap.en: The cost cap of {amount} {currency} is a cap that stops the run, not an expected cost: the run stops when there is not enough left for the next request; requests whose usage is uncertain keep their reservation
start.ack.cost_cap.zh: 费用上限 {amount} {currency} 是停机上限，不是预计费用：不够发下一次请求时就停下；用量不确定的请求按预留保留

start.ack.one_run.en: Starting for real (the first time the simulation is entered) uses 1 of your simulation runs; nothing is used if the check does not pass, or if you cancel or it expires before then
start.ack.one_run.zh: 真正开始（第一次进入模拟）时用掉 1 次启动机会；开始之前检查没有通过、取消或过期都不扣

start.ack.scope.en: I understand the scope and limits of this simulation: the results only describe life under these settings and are not a ranking of real cities
start.ack.scope.zh: 我知道这次模拟的范围与限制：结果只说明在这些设定下的生活，不是真实城市的排名

start.scope.check.en: Before starting, the service runs the pre-run check in the background (it does not use a run and does not call any model); closing the page, refreshing or losing the connection does not affect it
start.scope.check.zh: 开始之前，服务在后台做运行前检查（不使用次数、不调用模型）；关闭页面、刷新或断线都不影响

start.scope.gaps.en: The check may find that some city lacks data that a score needs: you will not be asked to confirm such ordinary data gaps again, and the results mark them as incomplete or missing (never filled with 0)
start.scope.gaps.zh: 检查可能发现某些城市缺少某项评分要读的资料：这类普通资料缺口不会再让你确认，结果里照实标为不完整或缺失（不补 0）

start.scope.once.en: This confirmation starts the simulation once: resuming after a stop is up to you, and simulating again after it ends needs a new start
start.scope.once.zh: 这次确认只开始一次：停下之后的恢复要你自己点，结束之后再模拟要重新开始

start.scope.stop.en: If the check does not pass, or the data, quote, scale, cost cap or the things you must acknowledge change, the service stops and explains why; it does not confirm again on your behalf
start.scope.stop.zh: 检查没有通过，或资料、报价、规模、费用上限与要知悉的事项变了：服务停下并说明原因，不替你重新确认
